清押洪到鄰鎮受審，公正嚴明的鄧官是倌的門生，他重打洪三十大板作懲戒。洪為了報復而殺掉福，更企圖污辱意，清趕至與他大打出手，清最後錯手殺死洪。洪母是倌的下人，她向倌施壓為子討回公道，倌卻稱洪死有餘辜，不肯相助。公堂上，昇以合法殺人為由替清辯護，無奈洪母卻咄咄逼人。她更毀滅證據，令昇無法救助清。昇繼續追查，發現洪母與倌有莫大關連。鄧請教倌如何判決，倌要他以社職安危為首，埋沒良心判清有罪。昇暗從倌處取來印有小足印的手帕，查察下發現足印屬於乾隆。昇向倌查問小足印的由來。

財得知雪有病後，鼓勵東與雪一起走過人生最後里程。東向雪表露真正身份，雪心生恐懼，昏了過去。妹等人知雪有病後，均在旁支持。希在賢家中遺留了一鈕釦，懵然不知。雪決定與東開心地過餘下日子。希成功令金脫罪，雪感不齒。Joyce為希選舉「傑出人仕」鋪路，就在此時卻發現希的鈕釦，於是取消希資格，希卻以為是雪所為。賢及希被Joyce捉姦在床，Joyce不幸滾下樓梯，賢故意將Joyce延遲送院。智查出雪會死於非命，兇手竟然是東。

(大結局)東將自己殺害雪一事告知雪，雪只感可笑。Sandy製造機會撮合邦及娥，但二人卻貌合神離。賢不斷玩弄Joyce及希感情，雪覺賢卑鄙至極。東決定避見雪，希望能阻止雪的死亡。媛得悉希不擇手段的向上爬，十分痛心，後竟遇上車禍，希將所有事情歸咎於雪。雪希望臨死前能見東一面，惜東處處逃避，是夜，希遇上雪，雙方發生糾纏，雪失足被車撞上，重傷去世。究竟希會有什麼下場；而東和雪是否從此陰陽相隔；至於邦及娥，又是否有緣在一起呢?請留意本集大結局。

(大結局)巧靈以載有伯軒罪證的密函與伯軒作交易，希望伯軒放過振銘。振鋒聽到巧靈的話，回家見到伯軒。惠琳想殺伯軒，振鋒勸阻卻被刺。振鋒指福全已答應為惠琳翻案，並提出與她成親，惠琳卻指要回普渡庵做住持……
Roger指貝兒最近只選購國棟公司的廚具，提議以後要有他與貝兒兩人簽名才作實。國棟吩咐家明將次貨廚師刀退貨，他因接電話而誤放。Roger約貝兒回內地玩笨豬跳，貝兒爽約。結果Roger向國棟索償一千萬。
思瀚指責眾男欺負定琪，要她採訪高危工作，卻原來是定琪自己爭取。恭教授希望思瀚助自己把吊飾還給定琪，恭教授更向思瀚說出定琪和兒子家諾是中學同學，因為家諾發生的事，令定琪無法釋懷。思瀚成功令定琪心結解開。

(大結局)東將自己殺害雪一事告知雪，雪只感可笑。Sandy製造機會撮合邦及娥，但二人卻貌合神離。賢不斷玩弄Joyce及希感情，雪覺賢卑鄙至極。東決定避見雪，希望能阻止雪的死亡。媛得悉希不擇手段的向上爬，十分痛心，後竟遇上車禍，希將所有事情歸咎於雪。雪希望臨死前能見東一面，惜東處處逃避，是夜，希遇上雪，雙方發生糾纏，雪失足被車撞上，重傷去世。究竟希會有什麼下場；而東和雪是否從此陰陽相隔；至於邦及娥，又是否有緣在一起呢?請留意本集大結局。
福全交令牌予振鋒以對付伯軒，但宮中隨時須取回令牌，振鋒不肯交還。伯軒派人到福興號搶銀両，釀成擠提，並收押振銘。貴祥聽到展良買兇殺振鋒。振鋒遇埋伏，慈恩出手相救。殺手深夜來襲，慈恩為救惠琳中刀……
(大結局)巧靈以載有伯軒罪證的密函與伯軒作交易，希望伯軒放過振銘。振鋒聽到巧靈的話，回家見到伯軒。惠琳想殺伯軒，振鋒勸阻卻被刺。振鋒指福全已答應為惠琳翻案，並提出與她成親，惠琳卻指要回普渡庵做住持……
思瀚指責眾男欺負定琪，要她採訪高危工作，卻原來是定琪自己爭取。恭教授希望思瀚助自己把吊飾還給定琪，恭教授更向思瀚說出定琪和兒子家諾是中學同學，因為家諾發生的事，令定琪無法釋懷。思瀚成功令定琪心結解開。
國棟向玫瑰說出稅務局追查舊賬，於是交託她盡快完成。國棟到立春的店舖替他維修，有裝修師傅出現指立春欠工錢。思瀚不慎弄壞了貝兒筆座，託國棟修理。貝兒見國棟在廚藝中心，暗示自己將去打保齡球，但國棟卻無反應。

當年，洪母目睹雍正將自己剛出世的女嬰與倌剛出世的男嬰調包，而此嬰正是乾隆，因乾隆不習慣吃其他母乳，洪母便受命進宮餵哺他。洪母知道得悉此天下秘密後必後患無窮，她遂印下乾隆的足印作證據，以保護自己一家。倌為要洪母保守秘密，多年來只好一次又一次的維護作惡多端的洪。昇終想出法子救意及清，並令洪母明白真正害死洪的是她自己。洪母不堪打擊，變成瘋婦，從此亦沒有人相信她的說話。清與意獲釋，眾喜。乾隆急召昇與清回宮；臨別依依，昇本欲向意表白，奈何意是乾隆心中所愛，昇只好將愛意埋藏在心底。
根阻截妻兒離港時遇意外，情急下謊稱藏有炸彈，被判入獄。森以「蛋糕羅賓漢」的姿態出現，送蛋糕給單親小孩，霜也收到蛋糕。根批評霜的蛋糕未達水準。沙巴翁邀根加盟，現任總廚Paul不滿，向根下戰書。
根以「黑森林海盜船」勝出比賽，霜指他抄襲作品。夢工場失火，霜的心血毁於一旦。根提議培育新學徒來提升餅房的水準，拉拒絕。霜見根在夢工場失火當日出現，認定是他縱火。霜為報復，到根旗下投考見習餅師。

MK仔司馬信在電子遊戲「強霸三國」中戰無不勝，專用諸葛亮作戰。司馬信與好友火咀、費查欲以二十萬頂手機舖，寄望在「強霸三國」公開賽贏取冠軍獎金。司馬信當電影場務散工時，發現二世祖志賢藏有搖頭丸而惹官非。警員到龍鼓灘拍攝現場找當臨記的司馬信，其時五百年一遇的颱風鯊魚迫近，天空出現奇幻色彩，司馬信跌進漆黑隧道。重現光明後，司馬信在懸崖邊救回一身古裝的范根，以為他同是電影臨記，豈料范根竟說二人身處荊州……

司馬信欲重返香港，惜時光隧道已消失，唯有跟范根回臥龍村。司馬信夜半拿出手機看相片，發現妹妹司馬娟的短訊。荊州牧劉表二子劉琮欲帶兵駐守臥龍村，村民擔心僅存的糧食要被上繳，幸得臥龍先生到來解難。司馬信驚覺眼前人是偶像諸葛亮，大為興奮，其熱情令諸葛亮吃不消……司馬信的手機又看到短訊，著妹妹請教曹教授回現代方法。司馬信無意中看到諸葛亮未婚妻黃月英，認為她配不上偶像。諸葛亮大婚之日，酒醉的司馬信批評月英……
貝兒在網上看到有回顧展將重播《被嫌棄的菜松子的一生》，令貝兒憶起采霞動手術時，國棟為自己所做的種種事，於是決定訂票重看，發現國棟也到了戲院。國棟終致電給貝兒約她吃飯。玫瑰看見國棟西裝打扮，不禁吃一驚。
立春得女性朋友幫助，再借一大筆金大展拳腳。貝兒終明白有關國棟與前妻、立春與美菁之間的關係。國棟為阻止立春簽約，與好友大打出手。國棟被玫瑰在出言教訓。貝兒把一盒砌圖送予國棟，國棟把砌圖完成時發現欠一塊。

當年，洪母目睹雍正將自己剛出世的女嬰與倌剛出世的男嬰調包，而此嬰正是乾隆，因乾隆不習慣吃其他母乳，洪母便受命進宮餵哺他。洪母知道得悉此天下秘密後必後患無窮，她遂印下乾隆的足印作證據，以保護自己一家。倌為要洪母保守秘密，多年來只好一次又一次的維護作惡多端的洪。昇終想出法子救意及清，並令洪母明白真正害死洪的是她自己。洪母不堪打擊，變成瘋婦，從此亦沒有人相信她的說話。清與意獲釋，眾喜。乾隆急召昇與清回宮；臨別依依，昇本欲向意表白，奈何意是乾隆心中所愛，昇只好將愛意埋藏在心底。
根阻截妻兒離港時遇意外，情急下謊稱藏有炸彈，被判入獄。森以「蛋糕羅賓漢」的姿態出現，送蛋糕給單親小孩，霜也收到蛋糕。根批評霜的蛋糕未達水準。沙巴翁邀根加盟，現任總廚Paul不滿，向根下戰書。
根以「黑森林海盜船」勝出比賽，霜指他抄襲作品。夢工場失火，霜的心血毁於一旦。根提議培育新學徒來提升餅房的水準，拉拒絕。霜見根在夢工場失火當日出現，認定是他縱火。霜為報復，到根旗下投考見習餅師。

MK仔司馬信在電子遊戲「強霸三國」中戰無不勝，專用諸葛亮作戰。司馬信與好友火咀、費查欲以二十萬頂手機舖，寄望在「強霸三國」公開賽贏取冠軍獎金。司馬信當電影場務散工時，發現二世祖志賢藏有搖頭丸而惹官非。警員到龍鼓灘拍攝現場找當臨記的司馬信，其時五百年一遇的颱風鯊魚迫近，天空出現奇幻色彩，司馬信跌進漆黑隧道。重現光明後，司馬信在懸崖邊救回一身古裝的范根，以為他同是電影臨記，豈料范根竟說二人身處荊州……

司馬信欲重返香港，惜時光隧道已消失，唯有跟范根回臥龍村。司馬信夜半拿出手機看相片，發現妹妹司馬娟的短訊。荊州牧劉表二子劉琮欲帶兵駐守臥龍村，村民擔心僅存的糧食要被上繳，幸得臥龍先生到來解難。司馬信驚覺眼前人是偶像諸葛亮，大為興奮，其熱情令諸葛亮吃不消……司馬信的手機又看到短訊，著妹妹請教曹教授回現代方法。司馬信無意中看到諸葛亮未婚妻黃月英，認為她配不上偶像。諸葛亮大婚之日，酒醉的司馬信批評月英……

怡發現波對露存好感，決想辨法撮合二人。怡不時慰問琛，希望撫平他的感情創傷。風考取超等成績，琛誤會他早前偷看試卷，後來知錯怪風。琛面對珊感壓力，珊亦害怕面對琛，志鼓勵琛追求怡，琛說出只視怡為妹。
聰與風等初次駕駛飛機，風犯嚴重錯誤，被罰停飛兩星期。欣得知聰是為追求她才投考機師，勸聰放棄，聰認清確是喜歡做飛機師。聰與風等成功考獲第一個機師牌。欣常與泰保持聯絡，泰為鼓勵欣考得機師牌而贈她平安符。
東與琛為慶祝學員考試過關搞慶祝會。孕婦在機場緊急接生，珊及怡其後嚷著要與女嬰上契。眾準備過最後考試後，結束在澳洲的訓練，準備返港繼續受訓。欣在訓練過程中表現超卓，如順利過關，她會是首位華籍女機師。
村校校長陸月暈倒入院，億章探望她時遇上來找豎佳的萬基，豎佳製造機會讓億章與萬碩碰面……億章憶起往事，原來慧晶當年喝醉後與人發生關係，疑為萬基或萬碩所為；萬基及後承認犯錯，遭億章逐出村；慧晶因醜事張揚，也隨母齊麗冰離村；億章發現萬碩拿酒給萬基、慧晶喝，才令二人做出錯事，揚言要與萬碩脫離父子關係，萬碩憤然離去。慧晶與楊沖先後探望陸月，慧晶告訴陸月已向校方辭職，陸月希望慧晶出任村校校長一職。
楊沖感慧晶為人功利，將她辭職的真相告訴陸月，陸月卻不以為然。億章氣憤下道出萬碩回港之事，其妻蔡如玉欲與家婆張結彩趕往醫院見萬碩父子，卻不慎跌傷。叔叔齊億宇使計支開億章，讓萬碩回村。萬碩憶起往事，原來他與萬基當年均愛上慧晶，慧晶鍾情萬碩，萬碩卻為萬基而迴避慧晶；中秋之夜，萬碩終和慧晶互相表白，及後與萬基、慧晶一起喝酒，慧晶、萬基先後醉倒……萬碩終於與如玉、結彩等家人團聚，此時億章突然回來……

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天淩晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家為了挽救低迷的事業,決心創作一部暢銷小說。他重返童年故居,這裡亦是其身為知名作家的父親當年神秘身亡之地。當他意外發現父親留下的最後手稿時,才驚覺這部作品遠超自己的才華。於是,他決定將..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer retreats to his childhood home to finish a novel and save his career. There, he uncovers the final manuscript left behind by his father, a famous writer who died mysteriously years earlier. Realizing the work is beyond his own talent, he decides to plagiarize it, unleashing horrifying supernatural events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鬼妻娜娜再次回歸,為一名遭受性侵導致流產的孕婦報仇。除鬼妻娜娜外,沒有人能認出襲擊者的身份。娜娜為報仇變成厲鬼,並要懲罰襲擊者的惡行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在朋友去世後,一群年輕人前往倫敦郊外的一座別墅,這裡隱藏著撲朔迷離的謎團。隨著度假期間詭異事件不斷發生,他們必須揭開別墅深藏的黑暗秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the death of their friend, a group of young adults travels to a villa on the outskirts of London that contains a deep mystery. As unsettling events escalate during their luxurious stay, they must unravel the villa’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,江南某古村接連發生死狀離奇的驚人命案,導致該地淪為方圓百里人人自危的嗜血鬼村「封門村」。記者李穆與警員萬楓結伴深入陰森詭異的荒村,在重重迷霧中抽絲剝繭。面對頻頻發生的靈異異象,他們能否徹底揭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A remote Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes known as the cursed ghost village Fengmen. Determined to uncover the truth, journalist Li Mu joins forces with officer Wan Feng to investigate the chilling incidents. As fear spreads among the villagers, the two risk their lives to expose the dark secrets behind Fengmen.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,江南某古村接連發生死狀離奇的驚人命案,導致該地淪為方圓百里人人自危的嗜血鬼村「封門村」。記者李穆與警員萬楓結伴深入陰森詭異的荒村,在重重迷霧中抽絲剝繭。面對頻頻發生的靈異異象,他們能否徹底揭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A remote Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes known as the cursed ghost village Fengmen. Determined to uncover the truth, journalist Li Mu joins forces with officer Wan Feng to investigate the chilling incidents. As fear spreads among the villagers, the two risk their lives to expose the dark secrets behind Fengmen.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,富甲一方的康氏慘遭滅門,唯一的目擊證人—家中的幼女—在親眼目睹全家被殺後離奇失蹤。幾十年間,位於青木巷的廢棄康宅充斥著靈異驚悚的氣氛。隨著真相逐漸揭露,這個恐怖的疑團交織著復仇與死亡的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

epg.programme_title_tc: Hide  Seek (aka The Last Hide  Seek)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十三年前,廢棄大廈的一場爆炸奪走了童的好友諾安。十三年後,童與昔日的朋友們重返故地,此地如今已成為他們就讀的大學校園。當一名與諾安容貌相同的女孩出現,兒時的遊戲化為索命的詛咒。復仇的惡靈再度甦醒,逐一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 資深主播艾米遭遇詭異蝙蝠襲擊後,帶著傷口返回電台,準備主持當晚的深夜節目。豈料竟遭無良老闆設局解僱,並被新人強行取代。適逢暴風雨封鎖整座電台,隨著傷口引發的異變愈演愈烈,艾米逐漸失控,在直播間掀起一場..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Radio host Amy is bitten by a mysterious bat, but she returns to the station to host that night’s late-night show. Instead, she is set up and fired by her ruthless boss, then replaced by a newcomer. As a violent storm traps everyone in the station and her mysterious wound worsens, Amy gradually loses control and unleashes a bloody massacre.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.programme_title_tc: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz (Ang Pagsanib kay Leah Dela Cruz)
epg.programme_title_en: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個冰淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豔麗女模余虹敏在一間盛傳鬧鬼的廢棄醫院中離奇身亡。事後,她生前的攝影師不斷接到如怨靈索命般的詭異來電,合作撰稿人突遭嚴重車禍,而她的摯友亦突然離奇失蹤。一連串毛骨悚然的怪事接踵而來,彷彿死者充滿妒恨的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.programme_title_tc: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz (Ang Pagsanib kay Leah Dela Cruz)
epg.programme_title_en: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個冰淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豔麗女模余虹敏在一間盛傳鬧鬼的廢棄醫院中離奇身亡。事後,她生前的攝影師不斷接到如怨靈索命般的詭異來電,合作撰稿人突遭嚴重車禍,而她的摯友亦突然離奇失蹤。一連串毛骨悚然的怪事接踵而來,彷彿死者充滿妒恨的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 菲律賓警方調查一宗極其殘忍、涉及邪教祭祀的離奇連環屠殺案時,在薄荷島救出唯一的倖存者,而她竟是一名隱姓埋名的前美國FBI探員。隨著調查不斷深入,她供述的遠古預言、惡魔附身與血腥祭祀,逐漸將所有人捲入一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While investigating a series of cult ritual massacres, Philippine police rescue the sole survivor on Bohol Island, who is a former FBI agent living under a false identity. As the investigation deepens, her accounts of ancient prophecies, demonic possession and bloody rituals draw everyone into a terrifying mystery where reality blurs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靜雯是一名努力奮鬥的戲劇學生,為了應付學費開支而接受了一份模特兒的工作。然而,當她為一位專門從事表現性人體素描的神秘藝術家擔任模特兒時,靜雯意外地揭露了一個驚人真相,更將她推向生死邊緣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jing Wen, a struggling drama student, takes on a modelling job to help cover her tuition costs. As she becomes a model for an enigmatic artist specializing in expressive human body sketches, Jing Wen accidentally uncovers a shocking truth, plunging her into a desperate fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 思南和丈夫前往吉隆玻度假,希望能緩解懷孕帶來的壓力。然而,她意外發現丈夫有個陰險的計畫,要將他們的孩子變成「碌葛」以謀取利潤,使她陷入危險之中。思南幸得酒店鬼魂的幫助,成功逃脫並報警將丈夫拘捕,最終安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a Luk Krok for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家為了挽救低迷的事業,決心創作一部暢銷小說。他重返童年故居,這裡亦是其身為知名作家的父親當年神秘身亡之地。當他意外發現父親留下的最後手稿時,才驚覺這部作品遠超自己的才華。於是,他決定將..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer retreats to his childhood home to finish a novel and save his career. There, he uncovers the final manuscript left behind by his father, a famous writer who died mysteriously years earlier. Realizing the work is beyond his own talent, he decides to plagiarize it, unleashing horrifying supernatural events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。淩晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Olivia是位出色的吸血鬼言情小說作家,一直渴望遇到真正的吸血鬼。當吸血鬼Luke出現在Olivia位於雪地的偏僻小屋向她求助時,她的夢想終於成真。然而,當Luke的吸血鬼同伴在平安夜那天追捕他時,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Olivia, an outstanding vampire romance novelist, longs to encounter a real vampire. Her wish comes true when Luke turns up at her remote snowbound cabin seeking for help. However, her dream transforms into a chilling nightmare on Christmas Eve when Lukes vampire companions track him down...

epg.programme_title_en: Detective Dee: The Ghosts in Weird Town
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑調查幽冥鎮接連發生的離奇僵屍變異事件,意外揭露幕後黑手竟是圖謀叛亂的越王李貞。面對亡靈肆虐與重重陰謀,狄仁傑憑藉機智與膽識力挫邪惡勢力,揭露了李貞的叛亂計畫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee investigates a series of terrifying vampire transformations in Youming Town, uncovering a sinister conspiracy masterminded by Prince Li Zhen, who plots to overthrow the empire. Armed with courage and ingenuity, Dee defeats the bloodthirsty vampires and ultimately exposes the prince’s dark ambitions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jas正與妹妹Laura享受著鄉郊的平靜假期,這份寧靜卻被一群突然出現的流浪漢徹底打破。Laura慘遭殺害後,Jas回到租來的小屋,發現妹妹冰冷的屍體。在悲慟與狂怒之中,她誓言追獵這群兇徒到底,定要其..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jass peaceful countryside getaway with her sister Laura is shattered when a group of drifters attacks them. After Laura is brutally killed, Jas discovers her lifeless body at their rented cabin. Consumed by grief and fury, she vows to hunt down the gang and take vengeance on her sisters murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. Before killing herself, she curses them to be haunted in their dreams. As the friends are killed off one by one, they must break the curse to escape their deadly fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. Before killing herself, she curses them to be haunted in their dreams. As the friends are killed off one by one, they must break the curse to escape their deadly fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.programme_title_en: Detective Dee: The Ghosts in Weird Town
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑調查幽冥鎮接連發生的離奇僵屍變異事件,意外揭露幕後黑手竟是圖謀叛亂的越王李貞。面對亡靈肆虐與重重陰謀,狄仁傑憑藉機智與膽識力挫邪惡勢力,揭露了李貞的叛亂計畫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee investigates a series of terrifying vampire transformations in Youming Town, uncovering a sinister conspiracy masterminded by Prince Li Zhen, who plots to overthrow the empire. Armed with courage and ingenuity, Dee defeats the bloodthirsty vampires and ultimately exposes the prince’s dark ambitions.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天台舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為逃離家暴陰影,Jennifer搬進212號公寓展開新生活,卻每天醒來身上出現詭異且疼痛的咬痕。她驚覺牆內潛藏著以活人血肉為食的古老寄生怪物。隨著襲擊加劇,面對這場嗜肉噩夢,她必須在被徹底蠶食之前,鼓..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

epg.programme_title_en: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz

As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕母親為女兒莫名失蹤而苦惱時,一連串怪異的事件接踵而至。這都可能與二十年前的意外亡魂為復仇歸來有關…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失憶青年馬可醒來時,驚覺自己被囚禁在一棟廢棄舊屋,四周屍橫遍地。在密閉空間內,他被迫按照神秘幕後黑手的指示,逐一播放隨身碟中的十段詭異錄像。隨著致命詛咒接連降臨,他不僅陷入恐怖幻覺,身體更逐漸異變,記..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amnesiac Marco awakens imprisoned in an abandoned house surrounded by corpses. Trapped inside, he is forced by a mysterious mastermind to play ten disturbing videos on a flash drive. As deadly curses unfold, he is plagued by terrifying visions while his body, memory and life slowly unravel. With the countdown to death underway, can he survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 菲律賓警方調查一宗極其殘忍、涉及邪教祭祀的離奇連環屠殺案時,在薄荷島救出唯一的倖存者,而她竟是一名隱姓埋名的前美國FBI探員。隨著調查不斷深入,她供述的遠古預言、惡魔附身與血腥祭祀,逐漸將所有人捲入一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While investigating a series of cult ritual massacres, Philippine police rescue the sole survivor on Bohol Island, who is a former FBI agent living under a false identity. As the investigation deepens, her accounts of ancient prophecies, demonic possession and bloody rituals draw everyone into a terrifying mystery where reality blurs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 資深主播艾米遭遇詭異蝙蝠襲擊後,帶著傷口返回電台,準備主持當晚的深夜節目。豈料竟遭無良老闆設局解僱,並被新人強行取代。適逢暴風雨封鎖整座電台,隨著傷口引發的異變愈演愈烈,艾米逐漸失控,在直播間掀起一場..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Radio host Amy is bitten by a mysterious bat, but she returns to the station to host that night’s late-night show. Instead, she is set up and fired by her ruthless boss, then replaced by a newcomer. As a violent storm traps everyone in the station and her mysterious wound worsens, Amy gradually loses control and unleashes a bloody massacre.

As deadly curses unfold, he is plagued by terrifying visions while his body, memory and life slowly unravel. With the countdown to death underway, can he survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 菲律賓警方調查一宗極其殘忍、涉及邪教祭祀的離奇連環屠殺案時,在薄荷島救出唯一的倖存者,而她竟是一名隱姓埋名的前美國FBI探員。隨著調查不斷深入,她供述的遠古預言、惡魔附身與血腥祭祀,逐漸將所有人捲入一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While investigating a series of cult ritual massacres, Philippine police rescue the sole survivor on Bohol Island, who is a former FBI agent living under a false identity. As the investigation deepens, her accounts of ancient prophecies, demonic possession and bloody rituals draw everyone into a terrifying mystery where reality blurs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 資深主播艾米遭遇詭異蝙蝠襲擊後,帶著傷口返回電台,準備主持當晚的深夜節目。豈料竟遭無良老闆設局解僱,並被新人強行取代。適逢暴風雨封鎖整座電台,隨著傷口引發的異變愈演愈烈,艾米逐漸失控,在直播間掀起一場..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Radio host Amy is bitten by a mysterious bat, but she returns to the station to host that night’s late-night show. Instead, she is set up and fired by her ruthless boss, then replaced by a newcomer. As a violent storm traps everyone in the station and her mysterious wound worsens, Amy gradually loses control and unleashes a bloody massacre.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕母親為女兒莫名失蹤而苦惱時,一連串怪異的事件接踵而至。這都可能與二十年前的意外亡魂為復仇歸來有關…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失憶青年馬可醒來時,驚覺自己被囚禁在一棟廢棄舊屋,四周屍橫遍地。在密閉空間內,他被迫按照神秘幕後黑手的指示,逐一播放隨身碟中的十段詭異錄像。隨著致命詛咒接連降臨,他不僅陷入恐怖幻覺,身體更逐漸異變,記..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amnesiac Marco awakens imprisoned in an abandoned house surrounded by corpses. Trapped inside, he is forced by a mysterious mastermind to play ten disturbing videos on a flash drive. As deadly curses unfold, he is plagued by terrifying visions while his body, memory and life slowly unravel. With the countdown to death underway, can he survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群漠視勸誡的年青人貿然闖進詭異森林露營作樂,入夜之後,他們內心的邪念驅使他們落入性與愛的關係陷阱,引來了森林裡一連串的靈異事件。黎明將至,他們當中有誰能逃生?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends goes on a camping trip inside a supposedly haunted forest despite warning not to do so. As night falls and camps are set, the complicated relationships of lust and love between them are exposed, triggering a series of paranormal events that punishes them.  When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.programme_title_tc: Hide  Seek (aka The Last Hide  Seek)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十三年前,廢棄大廈的一場爆炸奪走了童的好友諾安。十三年後,童與昔日的朋友們重返故地,此地如今已成為他們就讀的大學校園。當一名與諾安容貌相同的女孩出現,兒時的遊戲化為索命的詛咒。復仇的惡靈再度甦醒,逐一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家豪和朋友在別墅裡舉辦生日派對,卻意外地連接上了恐怖的虛擬實境遊戲《七夜》。原本歡樂的慶祝活動瞬間變成了一場令人恐懼的經歷。為了生存,他們必須在遊戲中點燃蠟燭,並小心避開遊蕩的鬼魂。隨著他的兩位朋友相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,富甲一方的康氏慘遭滅門,唯一的目擊證人—家中的幼女—在親眼目睹全家被殺後離奇失蹤。幾十年間,位於青木巷的廢棄康宅充斥著靈異驚悚的氣氛。隨著真相逐漸揭露,這個恐怖的疑團交織著復仇與死亡的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鬼妻娜娜再次回歸,為一名遭受性侵導致流產的孕婦報仇。除鬼妻娜娜外,沒有人能認出襲擊者的身份。娜娜為報仇變成厲鬼,並要懲罰襲擊者的惡行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天淩晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,江南某古村接連發生死狀離奇的驚人命案,導致該地淪為方圓百里人人自危的嗜血鬼村「封門村」。記者李穆與警員萬楓結伴深入陰森詭異的荒村,在重重迷霧中抽絲剝繭。面對頻頻發生的靈異異象,他們能否徹底揭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A remote Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes known as the cursed ghost village Fengmen. Determined to uncover the truth, journalist Li Mu joins forces with officer Wan Feng to investigate the chilling incidents. As fear spreads among the villagers, the two risk their lives to expose the dark secrets behind Fengmen.

香港知名證券商總裁羅敏生,在一宗為逃避跟蹤而引起的車禍受傷.保安科總督察何智強到場調查,發現了羅的汽車裏被裝上的軍用竊聽器.幾經追查,何找出了身份神秘的竊聽者司馬念祖,繼而查出了在香港股市呼風喚雨的神秘組織「地主會」.

隨着何智強一步一步地邁向真相,羅敏生,司馬念祖和「地主會」的角力不斷升級,駭人的事實逐漸被一一披露!然而,何智強亦不自覺地牽涉入這場鬥爭之中,一場股壇風暴即將掀起······

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在某公司任職的楊天樂,某天早晨接到老同學韓陽的電話,邀請大家到一處位於荒郊野嶺的老別墅聚會.約定的當天,天樂乘坐蔣為平的車來到別墅,老同學們三三兩兩到來.在這片幽靜的角落,他們有說有笑,好不吵鬧.誰知當聚會正在高超之際,一場暴雨突然而至,攪擾了眾人的雅興...
華孝曾與華孝麟奉父光之命，助皇帝找唐倩婷。曾不欲婷入宮選妃，讓婷寄居楊老師家中。麟得知真相，與曾反目。麟妻田錦釵助化解兄弟怨恨，並向皇上解釋。惜皇上怒氣難消，決治光死罪，幸楊向皇上提點，華家逃過大難。
張大成母親焦氏懷疑媳婦方慧珍鬼上身，仙姑獻計將珍釘死以治鬼。管家馬路通原來佈局謀害張家以奪產，二少奶月娥曾遭通污辱，受其威脅守密。仙姑為錢與通合謀，娥不忍終告知成真相，並當眾揭破仙姑與通的陰謀救回珍。
錢世吾欲將女兒碧茜嫁給董事長的兒子，茜為逃避婚事遂找夏明遠扮成假夫妻；遠妻李佩君亦不知情。吾知悉二人假結婚，故意要求補辦婚禮。婚禮日，君告遠重婚，遠惟有道出真相，時茜男友及時回國；吾被辭退，人財兩失。
江湖中人皆想學得歸化神音，峨嵋三劍與弟子馬如龍、柳雁秋與連彩鳳往找神音秘笈，卻遭青龍幫幫主胡聞浪截擊，幸得神秘女子尚玉燕相助。浪的女兒天嬌得悉浪實乃其仇人，惜她與秋同遭浪囚禁，燕遂聯同龍、鳳合力救人。

賈寶玉周旋於林黛玉與薛寶釵之間，唯他對黛玉痴情。家人欲替寶玉完婚，眾人屬意寶釵，但怕寶玉反對，故騙寶玉讓他娶黛玉。大婚之日，黛玉誤會寶玉負情病倒，寶玉得知受騙趕見黛玉，惜黛玉病逝，寶玉悲痛，決意出家。
周樸園與婢女侍萍發生不倫之戀，侍萍誕下兩子後被逐。長子周萍長大後，與婢女四鳳相戀，鳳珠胎暗結。誰料鳳是侍萍的女兒，侍萍不許兩人相見，兩人決定私奔。可是兩人得知身世後大受打擊，鳳觸電身亡，周萍吞槍自殺。
工廠少東王本甲奉父親之命，化名到工廠當見習技工，體察實情，廠長和秘書分別安排人進工廠調查誰是少東。甲在工廠認識女工何翠環，兩人生出愛火。正當眾人以為找到工廠少爺，甲父在壽宴宣佈甲身分，甲並與環成眷屬。
（續上集）馬如龍被離魂島的女賊捉去，尚玉燕殺女賊而觸怒島主宮天魁。燕等人助胡天嬌報父母之仇，魁乘時將連彩鳳擄走。龍為救鳳受重傷，燕等人往取地龍口涎醫治龍。紅雲祖師著燕交出神音秘笈，將之燒毀以平息紛爭。
阿鳳與阿偉相戀，卻被逼嫁予財主陳載福，鳳與偉欲私奔被捉，鳳為救偉而答允出嫁，婚後遵守婦道。後鳳重遇偉，她暗中撮合偉與其婢女阿香，豈料引起福與偉的誤會，被趕離家。鳳欲取回兒子時，惜家中失火，鳳不幸離世。

錦毛鼠白玉堂不忿展昭被封為御貓，一時意氣盜取包公的御賜三寶。昭為取回三寶獨自赴約卻被困，幸終逃脫，昭妻不知情往營救亦中機關。堂的結義兄弟為免堂一錯再錯，與昭施計救出昭妻並取回三寶，堂認輸道歉獲昭原諒。
韓雪梅為償還家中巨債應徵侍應，程經理垂涎梅的美色而聘用她。梅結識何英偉，兩人相戀。偉為替梅還債，虧空公款，被富孀楊太太以此要脅與她同居。梅女扮男裝接近楊，因而得知英的苦衷，並助英擺脫楊，二人終成眷屬。
富家女何美玲與派報女郎阿菲樣貌相像，玲討厭受家人管束，菲則渴望過千金小姐的生活。玲偶然認識了菲的好友莊文啟與華仔，因而機緣巧合下，玲與菲交換了身份。然而兩人均不適應對方的生活而逃走，最終回復身份回家。
林明珠被杜虬連人帶藏金地圖擄走，幸珠表姊張妙蘭與孟飛等人趕至救出珠，更找到當年被拐走的蘭弟。後蘭與飛被捉關於廟內，虬無意間發現藏金地。猺人大軍追至，虬被刺斃。珠尋回寶藏，並捐出黃金，期望漢、猺一家親。

鏢師竇勝來一次比武落敗後，負氣帶著妻子遠走他方，妻子誕下女兒後身故，來無奈賣女葬妻。女兒雲英被鄧夫人收養，與來骨肉分離。多年後，來重新振作，再開鏢局，他護送鄧夫人上京，期間大戰惡賊，最終與英父女相認。
金仲鳴邂逅方瑤芝，對她一見鍾情，時芝接獲三叔通知其父被殺的消息，故回港調查事件，鳴遂來港尋芝。芝輾轉查出殺父兇手及取得其販毒罪證，不料卻遭兇手挾持，幸鳴營救及協助，兇手終被警方所擒，鳴更向芝求婚成功。
杜文學與妻子遭緝捕，獲義兄周仁收留，惟學其後被抓。縣官嚴年垂涎杜妻美色，逼仁將其交出，周妻仗義代嫁年。學被判充軍獲救，更尋得延慶王爺伸冤；學誤會仁求榮背義，於公堂上對其施以酷刑，後杜妻尋至，道明真相。
佘仲全為捕蛇女周錦嫦所救，兩人甚為投契。全嫂花千嬌潑辣，常欺負全一家，讓全不滿。全與嫦欲共諧連理及開店，但屢遭嬌刁難，嫦不甘示弱，與嬌展開連場鬥法。嬌父窩娼聚賭、欺壓良民，被知縣拘捕，嬌亦得應有教訓。
金人欲奪抗金義士名單丹心冊，截殺馬騰雲，幸雲早已另藏丹心冊。義士頭領龍在田請來單君玉兄妹及申不識等高手相助尋回丹心冊。田等人得悉金人進駐龍王廟，懷疑丹心冊藏於其中，於是決定與金人正面交鋒，奮勇一戰……
珠寶行職員張立民為家中經濟支柱，其病及生活開支令他煩惱不堪。民因一時貪念而偷了公司的珠寶，欲於慶祝英女皇加冕的假期逃往外地。事情被其妻發覺，在她苦心勸導下，民懸崖勒馬，並得妻子協助暗中將珠寶放回公司。

晉懷帝遇上與他有緣的蝴蝶精，時玄杏湘將軍之妹身故，精遂借屍還魂，與帝結合；懷上龍種。太后得悉精身分，命湘將其勒死。帝決與精離去，精誕下龍胎後卻與帝分離。原來帝也是蝴蝶精再世，並化蝶登仙，與精再續情緣。
皇帝強召男丁入伍，花木蘭遂女扮男裝代老父從軍，並與柳元度、王忠義、安維吉齊參軍。大軍被番兵圍困，眾將推薦蘭「假扮」女子施美人計，終成功退敵。後來皇帝發現蘭以女兒身從軍，將她問斬，眾將力保，蘭得以免罪。
白蘭、陳志強分居，兩人分別撫養孿生女兒大寶與小寶。數年後，大寶與小寶相遇，兩人為了令父母破鏡重圓，計劃離家出走。白蘭、志強在女兒的生日會上相遇，大吵一場，不過此事令二人發覺最愛的人是對方，終一家團聚。
岳鳴邂逅富商梁道然之女采蓮，其後二人成婚，鳴由教學改行跟然做生意。鳴熱心校舍事宜與程淑荷來往，身懷六甲的蓮醋意大發，撞車身亡，幸女兒安然出生。然不肯原諒鳴，幸蓮之妹向然曉以大義，然終允許鳴與女兒生活。
惡霸楊飛虎欲借賑災義演歛財，眾鄉紳向黃飛鴻求助。虎得悉後設擂台與鴻比武，鴻因虎家人哀求並承諾勸說虎改過，故答應對虎手下留情。豈料義演日，虎並未覺悟竟帶人來搗亂，鴻出手教訓，虎母趕至，虎終醒覺求鴻原諒。

epg.programme_title_en: Love Story of Siu Pak Choy & Yeung Nei Mo
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 舉人楊乃武家有賢妻，卻傾慕豆腐小販葛小大的妻子小白菜，遭母親棒打鴛鴦。知縣之子鄭仁賚垂涎菜的美色，毒死大後收買官員，又教唆菜嫁禍於武。武姊上訴至太師，終替弟洗冤，而菜獲太后赦免死罪，帶著大的傻妹離開。
歸隱俠士鐵金剛奉命查魏州節度使田承嗣和潞州節度使薛嵩，並因武藝高強被嗣聘為統領。嗣派鐵金剛行刺嵩，可是鐵金剛不忍下手，後反被嵩所擒。嗣拘禁鐵金剛妻作脅，鐵金剛女兒紅線女惟有盜取嗣的寶盒，助嗣、嵩言和。
趙求胡扯賽馬貼士騙取金錢被識破，求妻對丈夫大感失望，留書出走。求的同事得悉求曾給的賽馬貼士全命中，向求下注，求挪用賭本開設食肆，豈料冷馬跑出，求走投無路而跳海。求妻往拜祭求，喜見求無恙，兩夫妻終和好。
富家子張永超對馮家婢女阿冰一見鍾情，假扮菜販結識她；超的司機阿德與洗衣女阿蘭相戀；德助蘭兄李明假扮闊少，認識千金小姐馮麗燕。最後超父張康年拆穿各人的騙局，幸年及燕父母放下門戶之見，三對有情人得成眷屬。
周千斤與盧鷹、朱風和王志找袁知農商討反清大計，惜遭暗殺，獨鷹倖存。斤妻待兒子飄長大成人後，命飄找朱、王、袁的後人，如海、月下、似風、天鳳和人龍一起查明真相。鷹使計擒獲鳳、龍，眾人前往營救，鷹中毒命危。

梁家全做粉果手藝一流，並與滿記一家感情要好。全欲與周月嫦結婚，卻被周母嫌棄，適財記重金禮聘全，全答應。滿記生意大減，全則受財記欺壓，於是全姊阿蘭代全上班，全偷回滿記，令生意逆轉。最終全亦得以重回滿記。
畫家于水村邂逅名歌女桃枝，二人共墮愛河。富商萬有光對枝鍾情，枝為免得失光，與光共膳，村誤會枝貪慕虛榮，拒見枝。枝嫁光為妾當日，光妻往找晦氣，幸村替枝解圍；兩人得悉彼此真心相愛，冰釋前嫌，終於走在一起。
（續上集）盧鷹身中劇毒，得女兒真真為其解毒。鷹跟蹤真，發現飄等人，眾人不敵鷹，幸袁人龍、天鳳兄妹和朱似風趕來營救。鷹擄走飄母，原來鷹弟鵰一直假冒鷹作惡，幸眾人救出鷹和飄母。飄等人為報父仇，最後殺死鵰。

白小燕刑滿出獄，偶遇陳探長之弟陳嘉亮，並從小偷手中取回亮的錢包。賊頭嚴方找上燕，再迫燕為他做不法勾當，燕立志改過自身，堅拒。亮與燕互生情愫，亮介紹燕到其學生林家當管家。方得知林家藏有價值連城的鑽石，於是以亮的性命，要脅燕幫他盜取鑽石，燕無奈答應。燕成功盜取鑽石後，方欲殺燕，幸探長率手下趕至阻止，並救出亮；原來探長早已知悉方打鑽石的主意，於是利用燕，並布下天羅地網，將方等人繩之以法。燕與亮結為夫婦。

書生余鳳聲與劉國仁傾慕名妓花醉紅，紅提出誰能金榜題名便嫁予他為妻，結果聲高中狀元。聲的庶母四姐欲為聲娶宦門美眷，聲妹明月遂施計讓四姐認識紅，並訛稱紅乃名門閨秀，四姐喜安排二人婚事，聲因而得與紅成眷屬。
金燕西對冷清秋傾慕，租下冷家旁的房子借故親近秋。西父金銓欲西與白雄起司令之妹成婚，然而西只鍾情秋，秋更珠胎暗結。西請祖母和繼母作說客，假意讓銓鑑賞秋的詩作，銓賞識秋才貌兼備，又見事已至此，遂答允婚事。
新任的遊樂場總經理阮秉南與歌女金露華互生好感，其未婚妻陳瑪莉因妒忌將華辭退。華後來收養了一棄嬰，卻被南的父母及莉誤會是南的骨肉，莉更因此與南解除婚約。最後棄嬰父親出現並取回嬰兒，南與華亦得以結成佳偶。
江湖正邪交戰，心池聖女獻身皇甫孤定下停戰盟約。聖女封存聖劍，待將來有能者憑劍號令正派，自己則在誕下孤子皇甫維後離去。二十年後，正邪再度交鋒，維奉孤之命阻止日、月、星三公作惡，而聖劍最後輾轉落於維手中。
陳玲、周大海、李明、亞全以行騙為生，玲對此生涯感厭倦，於是海提出要她誘騙慈善家謝雲，成功後便可收手。玲以美色吸引雲，讓雲對她展開熱烈追求，後雲更向玲求婚。玲為了離隊，遂讓全及明假扮其父母，騙取雲金錢。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncl

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝末年,光緒帝親政后,開始着手維新變法,惜改革觸犯了想保全自身富貴功名的官僚的阻擾。支持皇帝變法的康有為性格軟弱,堅持變法的譚嗣同難免浮躁,光緒深知自己的處境危險,於是企圖利用袁世凱去對付握有兵權的榮祿。但在關鍵時刻,袁世凱見風使舵卻向榮祿告了密,出賣了光緒...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu’s enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Impe

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女俠「金燕子」的兄長被山贼擄走,幸得武功高強的「醉俠」范大悲相助,從作惡多端的寺廟主持手上救出兄長。本片曾代表香港出戰第39屆奧斯卡金像獎最佳外語片的首輪評選。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The brother of the mystery swordswoman Golden Swallow” is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar “Drunken Cat” who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kong

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片是根據《聊齋》中之《書癡》改編,故事描述玉柱被叔叔郎中元欺負,搬進常鬧鬼的「孝廉府」。然後玉柱遇上了顏如玉,二人及後結成夫婦。郎中元之友史良金竟拐走如玉,將其迷奸。良金妻妾更毒害如玉,如玉化成厲鬼,將中元、良金等人殺害。玉柱因如玉已不在人世,不禁一陣辛酸。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wr

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一代宗師黃飛鴻在廣東教授功夫,卻被一名惡毒土匪陷害黃飛鴻的弟子,更以搶劫及謀殺等罪行誣陷他。因此,黃飛鴻誓要與土匪對抗力證自己的清白,並為弟子報仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wong’s disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歌舞團台柱陳君邁賦閒多時後,應徵當富家女梅倩如的司機,竟被誤傳戀情。倩如為查明流言的來源,假扮記者採訪歌舞團,期間君邁與倩如暗生好感,經過一番試探後,二人終一舞定情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明惠帝被篡位後,太子被藏匿在武林義士的黑龍會中,卻被武林敗類所襲擊,迫使入世未深的劍客及俠女帶著太子逃亡。他們一路上危機重重,幸得其他義士拔刀相助……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their jou

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 導演張堅庭在本片體現香港八十年代的大城小景;陳友與妻子惠英紅從大陸來港投靠父親,卻發現他並非如信中所言生活富足。東方之珠的美夢換來悲喜交集。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as City Lights

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝年間,少林派以反清復明為志,武當派卻為清廷所用,兩大門派因而逐漸形成敵對局面,並掀起一場又一場的打鬥…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窮書生林肇德與富翁女兒訂親,但富翁因其家道中落而反對婚事。為迎娶摯愛,肇德上京考取功名,臨行前會晤未婚妻,怎料卻碰上婢女滿身鮮血伏屍後花園。因不慎留下血手印於門上,他更被誣陷殺人。直至包公及時重審,為他洗脫冤情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family’s daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family’s background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancée, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody h

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 富家女田思思性格刁蠻任性,略通武藝。自從聽聞武林名俠秦歌﻿蓋世無雙的英勇事跡後,心生仰慕。她拒絕順從父親的婚姻安排,女扮男裝,私自出走尋找秦歌﻿,欲向他挑戰。豈料,途中卻誤入黑道陰謀的漩渦……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her father’s arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘭嶼紅蟲為患,島上人只信大頭目及巫醫巴達兩人。年青醫生何維德到蘭嶼找尋曾到此研究紅蟲而失蹤的父親,因而與未婚妻白丹娜鬧翻。後來何與孤女雅蘭相愛,惹來西呼達嫉妒;同時何為島民治病,令巴達信眾日減,西呼達、巴達均伺機殺何,何身陷險境而不自知……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 方剛的父親為救神風大俠齊如峰而死,齊如峰感念救命之恩,收留方剛入金刀門。方剛卻飽受師兄等人的歧視,於是決定遠走他鄉。齊如峰的獨女與方剛決戰時,竟用刀斬斷其右臂,方剛卻因此練成獨臂刀法,最終更挺身而出救助齊如峰。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述飾花花公子的喬莊與好友楊帆,同時愛上胡燕妮,但楊成人之美。但喬因生殖力弱,故當胡懷孕時,就懷疑妻與楊有染…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. Davids sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 影后李菁的代表作,蕭湘反串文必正,傾慕官府小姐霍定金,賣身混入霍家,二人私定終身,必正被陷害入獄,定金設法營救...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family’s young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo’s stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is fr

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三國時代,道士于吉憑藉精妙的道術醫好無數病人,深受百姓愛戴。不料,「小霸王」孫策認為于吉妖言惑眾,遂下令把他斬首。怎料于吉練成道術,被斬後,他的元神脫體飛出並向孫策報復。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Three Kingdoms period, a Taoist priest Yu Ji cures many patients with his supernatural powers and is loved by the people. However, the arrogant general Sun Che thinks that Yu Ji bewitches people and orders for him to be beheaded. Subsequen

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 記者仕泰爲發掘歌星小雲雀的秘密,假扮大亨接近小雲雀。後來仕泰的假大亨身份被揭穿,小雲雀大怒,請來真正大亨揭穿仕泰的身份。怎料大亨很欣賞仕泰的應變能力,實時聘請他爲助手,處理歌星登台事宜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the Little Lark in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,元初元人派大將軍莽依圖打擊反元分子;反元聯盟潛龍幫正處外憂內患,伏幫主、石副幫主雙雙去世,繼任人伏中原又為石夫人持信證明為元人,中原遂私下追尋身世真相。期間中原往將軍府盜取結盟名冊時,幾乎遇險,幸為女飛贼林雪兒所救…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 延續經典喜劇《72家房客》的成功,本片講述一羣住在香港唐樓的租客被發展商強行迫遷的故事。有些租客願意接受金錢賠償,但有些卻堅決反對。收購計劃最終又會否破壞鄰里間的和諧?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This film is an amusing insider’s look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang’s popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 聞蜚蛾自幼女扮男裝從父習武,後更考得秀才功名,堪稱文武全才。同窗好友杜子中與魏撰之雖與蜚蛾日夕相對,均不知其是女兒身。聞母見女兒年紀不小,不該再扮男裝,勸蜚蛾選撰之或子中為夫婿。不料蜚娥與二人情誼相同,一時無法抉擇,遂決定由天定奪,怎知陰差陽錯,選婿之箭落於撰之手中。蜚娥後悔不已,才知自己意屬子中…

故事圍繞主人公葉永彬、楊倩等公證人展開,他們作為司法工作人員,堅持職業操守,維護司法公正,通過一份遺囑引發的謎案,揭開人物之間錯綜複雜的關係與情感。

從小就期待著去找媽媽和妹妹的蘇盼,帶著父親的臨終囑託,踏上了加拿大的尋親路。看望多年不見的媽媽安娜和孿生妹妹蘇瞳。
三人最初的相處十分尷尬。安娜無論如何也走不進兒子蘇盼的內心。叛逆的妹妹更對這個`陌生人不屑一顧。而蘇盼懷著對當年母親離..

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《戰艦世紀》中,地球與強大的外星勢力展開一場橫跨海洋、天空與陸地的激烈戰鬥。由彼得·柏格執導,連恩尼遜、泰勒克奇與蕾哈娜領銜主演,呈現震撼爆炸級的海上動作鉅片。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Battleship, Earth battles a powerful alien force across sea, sky, and land. Directed by Peter Berg and starring Liam Neeson, Taylor Kitsch, and Rihanna, its explosive action at sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧斯卡金像獎®提名者西爾維斯特史泰龍主演的這部動作驚悚片,將帶您體驗腎上腺素飆升的快感,直到最後一格震撼人心的畫面!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Academy Award®-Nominee Sylvester Stallone stars in this explosive action-thriller that will keep you on the edge of your seat until the final, powerful frame!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名年輕人移居泰國並在一家冰廠工作,原本立誓絕不使用暴力,但在堂兄弟相繼失蹤、且發現該工廠竟是毒品走私的掩護後,他打破誓言以挺身對抗貪腐的大老闆。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Moving to Thailand to work at an ice factory under a strict anti-violence vow, a young boy breaks his oath to confront a corrupt boss after his cousins disappear and he discovers the business is a front for drug smuggling.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名落魄的德國水手在酒醉之下,同意駕船載送兩名英國女子從直布羅陀前往西印度群島,卻讓她們很快發現這趟航程絕不平順,唯有憑藉全部智慧才能活著抵達終點。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a washed-out German sailor in a drunken state agrees to take two British women from Gibraltar to the West Indies in his sailboat, they realize that it’s not going to be smooth sailing, and it will take all their wits to survive the trip.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一名黑人父親藉由殺死襲擊者來為遭到殘暴傷害的女兒報仇後,一位年輕律師必須在一個因種族緊張局勢和三K黨而陷入深度分裂的密西西比州小鎮上為他進行辯護。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a Black father avenges his daughters brutal assault by killing her attackers, a young lawyer must defend him in a small Mississippi town deeply divided by racial tension and the Ku Klux Klan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿諾史瓦辛格在《魔鬼孩子王》中飾演強悍的偵探約翰金布爾,他臥底成為一名教師,以尋找毒梟的妻子。這部經典的喜劇驚悚片充滿了動作、幽默和感人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Arnold Schwarzenegger stars as tough detective John Kimble in Kindergarten Cop, going undercover as a teacher to find a drug lords wife. Packed with action, humor, and heart, it’s a classic comedy-thriller.

epg.programme_title_tc: 奪寶大戰:尋找命運之矛的探險
epg.programme_title_en: The Librarian: The Quest For The Spear
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名書蟲成了新的圖書館員。就在同一晚,一支具有魔力的長槍被盜,他因此踏上環遊世界的實戰冒險旅程,尋回長槍——旅程的第一步,就是被他那可愛的助手從飛機上扔到亞馬遜雨林上空。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A bookworm becomes the librarian. Same night a magical spear gets stolen and hes off to get some real life experience around the globe on his quest for the spear - starting with being thrown off a plane over Amazonas by his cute helper.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一場前所未有的全球大流行疾病蹂躪地球後,資源變得極其匱乏,甚至必須以命相換。一位母親為了救活病重的女兒,不惜拼死一搏。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A mother fights to save the life of her ailing daughter after an unprecedented pandemic ravaged the planet, leaving resources so scarce you must pay for them with your life.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gerard Butler and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau star as rival gods locked in an epic battle to decide the fate of the universe in this thrilling fantasy-adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戰後的日本,哥吉拉的出現為滿目瘡痍的國土帶來了新的浩劫。當軍方無力介入、政府束手無策之際,倖存者們必須在絕望中團結起來,迎戰這股無情的恐怖力量。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿諾史瓦辛格在《魔鬼孩子王》中飾演強悍的偵探約翰金布爾,他臥底成為一名教師,以尋找毒梟的妻子。這部經典的喜劇驚悚片充滿了動作、幽默和感人。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席維斯・史特龍主演《???》,飾演一名失意英雄,在紐約市隧道崩塌之際,與時間賽跑營救受困通勤族。爆炸性的動作與懸疑氣氛,成就這部高風險災難驚悚片。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sylvester Stallone stars in Daylight as a fallen hero racing to rescue commuters trapped in a collapsing NYC tunnel. Explosive action and suspense power this high-stakes disaster thriller!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 第一次世界大戰期間,一名英國偷獵者、一名美國冒險家,以及他迷人的年輕女兒,聯手策劃摧毀一艘正在桑給巴爾外海灣進行維修的德國戰鬥巡洋艦。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During World War One, an English poacher, an American adventurer, and his attractive young daughter set out to destroy a German battle-cruiser awaiting repairs in an inlet just off Zanzibar.

epg.programme_title_tc: 奪寶大戰: 重返水晶骷髏王國
epg.programme_title_en: The Librarian: The Return To King Solomons Mines
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冒險家弗林.卡森收到一幅指向所羅門王礦脈的神秘地圖。當地圖被盜後,弗林踏上旅程尋回地圖及《所羅門之鑰》,一旦缺少這本書,地圖也將變得毫無用處。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adventurer Flynn Carsen receives a secret map to King Solomons Mines. When the map is stolen, Flynn sets out to find the map and the Key of Solomons book, without which the map is useless anyway.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李奧納多·狄卡皮歐與湯姆·哈迪主演阿利安卓·崗札雷·伊納利圖執導的這部史詩級震撼巨作。故事根據真實事件改編,背景設定在美國未開墾的荒野,講述一段關於生存與背叛的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hardy star in Alejandro González Iñárritus visceral, epic tale of survival and betrayal inspired by true events thats set in Americas uncharted wilderness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陳真回到20世紀初的上海準備與未婚妻結婚,卻發現自己敬重的武術師父神秘身亡。他隨即展開嚴酷的復仇行動,誓要對抗對此負責的日本對手武館。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Returning to early 20th-century Shanghai to marry his fiancée, Chen Zhen discovers his revered martial arts master has died mysteriously. He launches a relentless quest for vengeance against the rival Japanese dojo responsible.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 因為在拍賣會上取得魔法的「賢者之石」而忽略女友,弗林・卡森因此被命令去度假。來到紐奧良後,他卻忙於保護「猶大聖杯」,並試圖阻止吸血鬼威脅世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Losing his girlfriend because he was at an auction getting the magical Philosophers Stone, Flynn Carsen is ordered to take a vacation. In New Orleans he finds himself busy protecting the Judas Chalice and saving the world from vampires.

To prove himself, he sets out on a journey to find his own success but faces repeated setbacks. In despair, he reconnects with an old classmate who collaborates with him on a business venture, resulting in a series of amusing and chaotic escapades.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Zhang investigates a peculiar murder case in Taiping Town where villagers believe a female ghost is responsible. As Zhang investigates, more murders occur, sparking rumours of paper demons and vengeful wraiths. With the help of Beggar Gou Zi, Zhang finds the culprit and unveils the secret behind the serial murders.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tian Yi is destined to fail as an immortal in heaven. When he accidentally frees Snowy and makes her a demon, he wanders in hell for thousand years to right his wrong. After a series of hardships, Snowy and Tian Yi manages to get married, but the heavenly warriors attempt to arrest Snowy. Can the couple live happily ever after?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his sister, top martial artist Constable Xie is forced by the Monster King to find all magical weapons for a tactical plot. The Monster Kings real purpose is to suck peoples blood and control the world through eudemon. Knowing his evil plan, Constable Xie decides to unlock his hidden power and begins a fierce battle with Monster King.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 濟公即將在突破最後一層成為降龍羅漢的關鍵時刻,感應到白水鎮村民有難,於是他放棄修行前往白水鎮解救百姓。在這裡他遇到了假扮濟公的黃元蠱惑百姓,差點把濟公燒死,但最終黃元被濟公所感化,並幫助濟公一起降魔伏..

He encounters Huang, who impersonates him and bewitches the villagers, leading Ji Gong to be nearly burnt alive. When Huang is finally enlightened by Ji Gong, he joins him to subdue the demons.

However, as Rose and Hao fall in love, she faces a heart-wrenching dilemma — choosing between her duty to bring him down and the irresistible pull of their intensifying romance.

When the town is besieged by a spider demon, the four disciples have to overcome their conflicts and unite to save the people.

He is forced to flee and with the help of his companion, Zhang finds the sole survivor of the murder. The trio launches an investigation and strives to uncover the truth, which seems to be connected to a human smuggling gang and a military organization.

A century later, Zhangs disciple, Lin, assumes leadership and discovers that the spirits of the vanished women are devoured by Emperor Yu for boosting his power. epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nine-tailed Fox is caught by the seven monkey monster in Mount Mei. Jiang Zi Ya inadvertently saves Nine-tailed Fox but cuts off one of her tails, making her so desperate that she possesses the body of Da Ji. Shortly after, Emperor Shang invades Ji Zhou and kidnaps Da Ji, who later becomes Empress Shang and causes chaos throughout the realm.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Chen Dynasty, Chen Ling is assigned to investigate a supernatural case in Wu Xiang City. There, a man who pretends to help Chen Ling wants to steal a supernatural plant whose poison will cause people to bite each other, so as to take revenge on Chen and the master who killed his tribe. A fierce battle has just begun!

Three years later, Zhang infiltrates a drug lab in an investigation, only to discover that it is operated by his former teammate Hu. It is when Ge Zhen investigates a case that he encounters Qiu Kui and they fall in love. At the same time, Wu Ma, the most powerful killer in the squad is mysteriously murdered. Ya Mei sneaks in and helps her teammates to escape by setting off a bomb, at the same time faking the death of herself and her fiancée. Three years later, Mei must resume duty to fight against Ba Song in order to save her kidnapped fiancée.

During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

A restauranteur leads her staff to fight against the triads and protect the weak. They team up with the residents to combat the triads and fight against the corrupted police, finally restoring peace and harmony.

Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.
