A year later, she learns from the newsmonger Bao that the massacre was orchestrated by a bandit who wants to avenges his fathers death caused by Rus father. With the help of Bao, Ru vanquishes the lackeys of the bandit and seeks her own vengeance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 初任上海警察隊長的陳虎接到一樁命案,軍政部部長之子何滿君離奇死亡。何是聖馬丁高中的一名學生,為了獲得破案信息,陳喬裝學生混入學校。他一邊查案,一邊與各方勢力展開較量,而何之死迷霧重重,一個又一個嫌疑人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The son of a minister is mysteriously killed. The newly appointed police inspector Chen Fu, goes undercover as a secondary student to investigate the case. As he carries on investigation in the school, Chen encounters different potential suspects, making the case more mysterious. What is the cause of the murder and who is the killer?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漁民子豪生活在海邊小鎮歸港,以捕魚為生。有一天,他偶然遇到一位神秘的女孩小藝,兩人互生情愫,終於走在一起。但好景不長,突然有一個名叫老金的神秘中年人到來,揭開了小藝真實的身份竟然是人魚族!子豪能否接受..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fisherman Zi Hao lives in a small seaside town and earns a living on the water. One day, he finds himself enchanted by a mysterious woman Xiao Yi, and they fall in love.  However, a strange man appears and uncovers the true identity of Xiao Yi as a mermaid one day.  Can Zi Hao face the truth and can Xiao Yi keep the secret of the mermaid tribe?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 韓渺是八仙之一韓湘子的化身,在一個缺水猶如沙漠的世界一路向東歷練。而正在執掌東海的龍女因失去記憶,化成了一條魚精,意外遇到和自己有宿世因緣的韓渺。二人走在一起,在東遊途中受到高人指點去尋找 “龍門 ..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Han Miao is one of the eight immortals living in a desert. Dragon Maiden, who helms the East Ocean, loses her memory and becomes a fish demon. When she encounters her destined lover, Han Miao, they quickly fall in love. With help from a guru, they set out for Dragon Gate where Dragon Maiden can resume her identity and locate the water source.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 未來的地球資源匱乏,各國頂尖科學家將數種動植物的物種送往火星培養,希望改善火星的環境能夠適合人類居住。然而生物在實驗中開始發生變異攻擊人類,身在火星的專家們情況十分危險。中國派出太空人進行救援,他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elite scientists worldwide plan to cultivate several plant and animal species on Jupiter to combat resource scarcity on Earth. However, the species mutate and attack the scientists. Chinese astronauts are sent to Jupiter on a rescue mission, and they fight fearlessly against the unknown species to save the scientists there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了取長補短,陳真遠赴日本學習工業技術。留學期間,陳真與擅長形意拳的武術家薛自立一起,為了捍衛中國人民的尊嚴,他們勇敢面對日本軍部官員的比武挑戰。一場中國功夫大師與日本武士的較量正式上演,比武場上陳真..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Chen Zhen travels to Japan to learn industrial technology, he teams up with martial artist She Zi Li, and accepts a duel challenge from the Japanese military officials to uphold the Chinese dignity. In a battle of Chinese kung fu master agianst the Japanese samurai, Chen showcases the unique finesse of Chinese kung fu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 胡八一與王胖子及大金牙在古蘭郡遇到Shirley楊,得知孫教授被困於龍嶺迷窟。四人一起進入迷窟尋找教授,出來後胡和王身上長出眼球狀的紅斑,根據Shirley外公的筆記,解藥雮塵珠有可能藏在黑水城的通天..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three friends meet Shirley in Gu Lan County. They save a professor trapped in the Dragon Labyrinth, but two friends suffer from skin rashes after leaving the labyrinth. According to the notes written by Shirleys grandfather, the antidotes may be hidden at Tong Tian Buddhist Temple, so the four of them set off on a challenging journey for the cure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 首屈一指的馴鳥師茅山豪,在鳳凰島遭遇變異物種襲擊,並不斷有人離奇失蹤,人心惶惶。為了探尋真相,豪與治安隊隊長孟前冰釋前嫌,並通力合作調查此失蹤案。可怕的是,線索竟指向與僵屍有關!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Phoenix Island is attacked by a mutated object, causing people to mysteriously disappear and inducing panic. Top bird trainer Mao Shan Hao teams up with a  security team leader to investigate the case. The search intensifies as they uncover clues linking the missing victims to zombies, adding a thrilling twist to the case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 九門的陸尋與同僚大山受命保護兵部尚書鄭巖,但鄭突然離奇死亡。陸在調查中發現舞女封如月與其兄封空空可疑,但空空卻意外失蹤。陸循著線索,帶著大山、如月來到黑澤城,在執行公務的過程中無意被捲入驚天陰謀。陸在..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lu and Da are assigned to protect a military officer, but he dies suddenly. As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙腿殘疾的童松是矛盾安保公司的創始人,團隊中還有擅長機械的安寧和身手了得的大牛,公司主要是保護客戶安全,俗稱“保鏢。這天,他們接到一個匿名委託,要保護的人正是安寧的妹妹安逸,之後逸便頻生意外。童發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Handicapped Tong is the founder of a security company. His team includes mechanical expert An Ning and martial arts expert Da Niu. One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南方一座城市中突發一起爆炸危機事件,排爆特警在第一時間展開迅速救援和周密偵破。為排除其他爆炸隱患,守護群眾安全,特警馬進和朱江等人衝鋒在前,不斷化解炸彈危機。排爆隊員在全城展開排爆行動與犯罪分子之間..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a sudden explosion in the city, the anti-explosion team dashes to the scene to rescue and investigate. Led by Officer Ma and Officer Zhu, they prioritize peoples safety and set out to prevent further explosions. Tension mounts as the situation becomes increasingly volatile. Can the team defeat the odds and bring an end to the crisis?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐時期垂拱元年,武則天率領百官坐龍船夜巡運河,各人奔向龍門只為一睹天后聖容,沒想到卻在運河之中遭遇龍形異獸衝撞龍船,引起了百姓的議論,認為是不祥之兆。武則天對此事件勃然大怒,召見狄仁傑前去調查運河龍王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Empress Wu and her officials patrol the Grand Canal one night. As the crowd rushes to see her in person, a dragon monster appears and hits on the vessel. This is believed to be an ominous sign. Empress Wu is angry and asks Detective Di to investigate the case. Detective Di uses his investigative mind to unravel the truth and find the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 弟弟杜家豪在上水鎮被水猴子殘殺,民國女法醫清伶為了探尋真相便前往上水鎮探尋原因。在這詭異的村莊,關於水猴子復仇的“詛咒接二連三發生。清伶携槍勇闖水怪禁地黑木林,而她力憑科學文明剷除水猴子的封建迷信,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Forensic pathologist Qing investigates her brothers murder by the water monkeys in a town where the curse of a vengeful monkey ensues. Armed with a gun, Qing ventures to the forbidden land of Water Monster and debunks superstitions with scientific facts, ultimately leading the villagers to fight against the evil forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 弟弟杜家豪在上水鎮被水猴子殘殺,民國女法醫清伶為了探尋真相便前往上水鎮探尋原因。在這詭異的村莊,關於水猴子復仇的“詛咒接二連三發生。清伶携槍勇闖水怪禁地黑木林,而她力憑科學文明剷除水猴子的封建迷信,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Forensic pathologist Qing investigates her brothers murder by the water monkeys in a town where the curse of a vengeful monkey ensues. Armed with a gun, Qing ventures to the forbidden land of Water Monster and debunks superstitions with scientific facts, ultimately leading the villagers to fight against the evil forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金傲為保護中華傲決與無敵大戰,在生命垂危的時候將中華傲決傳授給華英雄。然而擁有“天煞孤星命格的華英雄失去了父母及妻子,離開了兒女,潛心修煉二十年卻始終無法參悟中華傲決。最終,華為了所有中國人要與無敵..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jin Ao battles with Wu Di to preserve the Pride martial arts skill, which he passes to Hero Hua before he dies. Hua, who is born under the curse of the Star of Loneliness, leaves his family to practise the martial arts skill for 20 years, but still fails to master it. Can Hua finally master the skill and defeats Wu Di to save his people?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張騫奉漢武帝之命率領百餘人組成使團出使大月氏,中途卻遭匈奴截殺及俘虜。張及部份生還的使團成員淪為階下囚,被軟禁十年之久,原本要實行密謀多年的逃跑計畫也被突如其來的一場匈奴與大漢將軍的戰爭打破。儘管如此..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Appointed by the Emperor Han, Zhang leads a diplomatic mission to Greater Rouzhi, but they are either killed or captured by the Huns on the way. Zhang and the captives are imprisoned for 10 years and the battle between the Huns and Han destroyed their long-awaited escape plan. Zhang vows to overcome the trials and bring the captives back to Han.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金蓮是扶桑之寶,卻被紅狐紅綃、白狐傾城及黑狐夜桑在爭奪時意外遺失。扶桑之主姥姥本想利用金蓮意圖掌控天下,立即命令三狐下凡往人間尋找金蓮。三狐發現金蓮附身在一個名叫張懷生的人身上,而金蓮的力量亦恢復了各..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Golden Lotus, the Fusos treasure, is lost. Fusos demoness orders three fox demons to find it in the human world. The fox demons soon discover that Zhang Huai Shen has taken the golden lotus, which has the power to recall the memories of past lives. This eventually uncovers the relationship between Zhang, the three fox demons and the demoness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 黃河邊的一個小村落,有一口浮棺出現後,村中怪事頻發。撈屍人趙家帶人下水查探,但只有家主一人生還。多年後浮棺再現,千年巨蛇亦浮出水面,趙家後代趙佰用祖傳秘術來對付巨蛇。另外陳家因盜墓受到詛咒,壽命很短,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A floating coffin triggers a series of disasters in the village and only a member of the Zhao family survives. Years later, the coffin reappears with a serpent and a Young Zhao vows to kill it. Meanwhile, the Chen family is cursed and it can only be broken by the floating coffin. This results in the two families teaming up in a dangerous adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋年間,在方圓八百里之地有少俠與飛雲客棧的夥伴們聯手協助將軍李顯忠展開北伐,收復失地。但他們的努力卻遭到副將邵宏淵的嫉妒和破壞,最後導致北伐失敗。眾人非常氣憤,誓要捉拿邵宏淵,並要協助百姓們安全撤離..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Song era, a young master and staff at Fei Yun inn aid General Li Xian Zhong to recover the lost territory in a northern expedition. However, Deputy General Shaos jealousy and sabotage cause the mission to fail. Fueled by anger, the team vows to capture Shao while helping the civilians to evacuate.

epg.programme_title_en: Seventeen and a Half Years Old
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張君佳是一名高中學生,為了接近校花黃巧姍,他想拍一部微電影,讓黃巧姍主演。藝術節快要到來,他決定組織同學們拍一部校園喪屍片,拍攝期間,眾人幾經波折,劇組更瀕臨於崩潰邊沿。然而友情、親情和愛情交織成的共..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhang Jun Jia directs a micro movie starring the school girl he likes. As Arts festival approaches, Zhang and his classmates decide to make a college zombie movie. They encounter many difficulties in the process and despite the production team falling into pieces, they manage to overcome the challenges with love amongst friends, family and lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年青鐵匠呂三思偶遇自己崇拜的大俠百里無憂。他幫助大俠押送西廠走狗何清纓,但何卻對他說了另一個版本的故事,說她是被西廠迫害,而百里才是出賣義士的走狗!事情越來越可疑,何不一定是走狗,而百里也可能不是大俠..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young blacksmith Lui encounters his idol, Swordsman Bai Li, and helps Bai deport He Qing Ying, a lackey of the emperors secret agency. However, He claims that she is innocent while Bai Li is the one who has betrayed the patriots. Things become suspicious and Lui is unsure of whom to trust. Who will he trust in the end?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔族在雲盛皇朝興風作浪,皇帝突死於怪病,在臨終前將盛寧公主下嫁伏龍大將軍白奕。公主向太后請求悔婚遭拒絕,漸漸兩人相處後關係緩和,公主發現自已對白奕已芳心暗許。及後公主被魔族尾火虎挾持,白奕在混戰中救出..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon cult prevails in the Yun Sheng dynasty. The Emperor arranges the princess to marry General Bai Yi before he dies, but the princess wants to end her engagement. When the princess eventually falls for Bai, she is kidnapped by the demon cult and Bai is killed in a fight while trying to save her. Will the couple be separated forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,觀山太保傳人封四九為了幫助籌募軍餉,答應鄭大帥嫡子鄭東西請求,尋找死在千季古地宮“九館裡的遺體。鄭其實想找尋寶物,同時又找了發丘中郎一族後代陳青山一同參與。眾人幾番陷入兇險,幸好陳與封互相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To raise funds for their troops, Master Feng agress to help Zheng Dong Xi find corpses within an ancient tomb. Zhengs true motive is to uncover the tombs hidden treasure and he also enlist the help of Chen. Together, they embark on a perilous expedition to hunt for the treasure as well as to help the people.

epg.programme_title_tc: 伏妖開封府之御貓展昭
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北宋時期,宦官專權,邪靈橫行,汴梁境內興起了許多邪教,其中最大勢力是“外九流。開封府裡的包拯、展昭和公孫策秘密審理邪靈案,然而“外九流的人試圖毒害包拯,還籌劃著更龐大的陰謀。面對此情況,開封府眾人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eunuchs are powerful in the Northern Song Dynasty as evil religion sects emerge, with the largest one being “Wai Jiu Liu”. As Justice Bao, Zhan Zhao and Gong Sun Ce secretly preside over the trials involving evil spirits, the disciples of “Wai Jiu Liu” try to poison Bao and hedge a huge plot. How can Justice Bao tackle the plight?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青山大學著名植物學教授霍玉春研發出一種可以讓植物與動物DNA相結合的新病毒。此時女學生羅柯向教授的助教鄭問表白,兩人墜入愛河之際,病毒突然在學校中爆發,柯不幸受感染被隔離。為了拯救學校及柯,鄭問找到教..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Huo, a famous university botany professor, uses animal and plant DNAs to develop a virus. His assistant, Cheng, falls in love with his student, Ke, but Ke gets infected during a sudden virus outbreak in the university. To save Ke and the university, Cheng stumbles upon the professors secret laboratory and unveils a secret between Huo and Ke.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江城傳奇神槍手“鬼手,被保護江城安寧的羲和堂以叛徒之名追捕。小混混陸瀾意外得知哥哥被鬼手所殺,為了復仇加入羲和堂,在女殺手冷楓的培養下成長為一名頂尖槍手。陸決意殺掉鬼手為兄報仇,在生死槍戰之際卻發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Legendary sniper Ghost Hand is hunted by the Yi He gang that is responsible for safeguarding the city. Lu Lan joins the gang to take revenge on Ghost Hand who has killed his brother. After training to become a top sniper, Lu Lan uncovers the true identity of Ghost Hand during a shootout and uncovers the conspiracy of Yi He gang.

epg.programme_title_tc: 武狀元蘇乞兒之天降神諭
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝末期,西方列強在中國橫行霸道,百姓民不聊生。此時民間天降“神諭,傳言大清要亡,加上顧命大臣接連暴斃,讓傳言更加沸騰。皇上任命九門提督富察·禦恒徹查此案,富察也請來好友蘇燦幫忙。燦發現刺客應該是用..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the late Qing dynasty, people are suffering from destitution. A divine omen and death of some ministers have sparked rumours of Qings downfall. Fu Cha is tasked by the Emperor to investigate, so he enlists the help of Su Can, who uncovers a brutal assassination plot involving illusions and unravels the secret behind the case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大唐盛世時期,曲江池天降妖龍異象,導致長安百姓一夜禿頭,令聖人勃然大怒。黃河縣令王玄秘密調查此案,發現背後竟有人密謀屠城計畫,影響到聖人安危。王玄深入偵查龍王教,過程中破解了金鯉迷局,更識破了屠城計畫..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the Tang dynasty, a fallen demon dragon causes the people of Qujiang City to mysteriously go bald overnight. Outraged, the Emperor assigns Magistrate Wang to investigate the case. Wang infiltrates the secret Long Wang Cult and exposes their plot to instigate a massacre, eventually saving the emperor and protecting the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋朝年間,法醫宋慈來到長汀縣任職。一天晚上,突然有一男一女同時喪命,宋得知後立刻介入調查,驗屍過後發現事有蹊蹺,並不是簡單的殺人案。此時宋想到了丹青,可以說在長汀縣沒有丹不知道的事情。倆人於是合作找尋..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Song dynasty, Changdings newly appointed forensic scientist, Song Ci, probes into the sudden deaths of a man and a woman. His inquest reveals a mysterious murder plot, and Song Ci decides to join forces with Dan Qing, who knows everything about Changding County, to unravel the truth behind the murders.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傅炎為了拯救瀕臨死亡的藍墨伊,毅然前往上古戰場神佑之地,尋找神炎來救藍。上古戰場分三層,他們剛從外層降服了守護獸赤墨玄蛟時,便遇到蒼岩宗宗主蒼石靈君。然而傅及石二人要爭奪對方的半張藏寶圖,在一番激戰後..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: u sets out to find the Godly Flame and save the dying Nan. On his way, he encounters Master Shi of Can Yan Sect when vanquishing a guardian beast. Fu and Shi battle for their respective halves of the treasure map but eventually reconciled after a fierce fight. Both decide to share the map and team up to search for the treasure and the Godly Flame.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傅炎為了拯救瀕臨死亡的藍墨伊,毅然前往上古戰場神佑之地,尋找神炎來救藍。上古戰場分三層,他們剛從外層降服了守護獸赤墨玄蛟時,便遇到蒼岩宗宗主蒼石靈君。然而傅及石二人要爭奪對方的半張藏寶圖,在一番激戰後..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: u sets out to find the Godly Flame and save the dying Nan. On his way, he encounters Master Shi of Can Yan Sect when vanquishing a guardian beast. Fu and Shi battle for their respective halves of the treasure map but eventually reconciled after a fierce fight. Both decide to share the map and team up to search for the treasure and the Godly Flame.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在剿滅東南亞最大的犯罪組織救世會時,金泰在任務中誤殺了自己的師傅金銘。泰極度自責,默然離開特工組織。然而消失多年的救世會再次出現,泰更得知組織的頭目竟是死而復生的銘,令他一蹶不振,直到一個男孩的出現,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Secret agent Tai accidentally kills his master Ming, as he tries to destroy a powerful criminal gang. Tai is so guilty that he decides to leave the agency, but the gang with Master Ming as its head, reappear years later. Devastated by his masters deception, Tai returns as an agent to settle their grudges after being inspired by a young man.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大清年間,偏遠的臨江縣有兩名縣令接連被大蟒蛇咬死,百姓人心惶惶。侍衛蘇乞兒和鐵橋三奉命前往臨江縣調查此案。兩人發現當地毒品極樂丸極為盛行,而在調查當中鐵橋三與蘇乞兒也因極樂丸陷入困境。在逆境面前他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1928年的上海灘,新生勢力龍德商會為擴大地盤與老牌勢力通明堂產生利益衝突,雙方摩擦不斷。通明堂小少爺周放,因父親被殺要為父報仇,帶領眾人對決龍德商會,卻在復仇過程中與商會二把手林海惺惺相惜。然而二人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1928 Shanghai, a new triad gang plans to expand their territory, causing conflicts with the old triad gang. As the son of the old triad boss seeks revenge for his fathers death, he accidentally makes friend with the new triad boss right-hand man. However, as the two are destined rivals, a fatal battle between them is inevitable!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孫悟空被壓五指山下四百年時,碰巧被阿一所救。而龍太子得知悟空已逃出,要報當年東海龍宮被毀之仇,便利用悟空昔日好友蛟魔王刺殺悟空,但刺殺失敗,不過阿一被俘虜。為了救阿一,悟空與龍太子從海里打到南天門。最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trapped under Mount Wuzhi for 400 years, the Monkey King is saved by Ah Yi, but is targeted to be assassinated under the Prince Dragons orders. Though the mission fails, Ah Yi is captured and Monkey King battles the Prince Dragon across land and sea to rescue her. He finally redeems himself and returns to Mount Wuzhi to continue his training.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊境小鎮妖魔遺禍,吳靖子發出請柬,請各位降妖高手前來支援。市井遊民阿拾,意外被孟珠救下後竟愛上孟珠,要拜她為師,一路跟著孟珠及其他降妖高手前往小鎮去消滅在雲棧洞內的千年豬妖。最後阿拾以自己的性命為代價..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Jing Zi seeks help from demon hunters to cast away the evil spirits in town. Saved by demon hunter Meng Zhu, Ah Shi falls in love with her and becomes her disciple. They journey to Yu Zhan Cave to kill the Pig Demon with other hunters. In the end, Ah Shi sacrifices himself to let the hunters fight their way out, but the result is unexpected...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年閻晃跟著身為撈屍人的師父老姜,在天水村遇到離奇事件,傳聞二十年前有水怪禍亂屠戮村莊,現在怨靈回魂伺機索命,流言四起。在調查期間,閻在林瑤及老姜等人的幫助下堅定立場,不被封建迷信所蒙蔽,努力探尋真相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rumour has it that a water monster destroyed the village 20 years ago, and now its vengeful spirit has returned. As Yan and his master encounter mysterious incidents in the village, Yan decides to find out the truth without being influenced by superstitions. In the process, Yan discovers his true identity and captures the real culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗美援朝戰爭時期,志願軍三排排長孟大關臨危受命,帶領小隊前去解救被困敵後的偵察排。經歷了一系列艱難險阻,孟與由杜川帶領的偵察排終於成功匯合。為了避免部隊有更大傷亡,孟與杜在危急關頭果斷決定,要困死那個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meng, a Volunteer Army platoon leader, is commissioned to rescue a platoon in captive. Through arduous trials, Meng teams up with another platoon leader, Du. They decide to contain the enemys artillery supply to reduce casualties, and vow to dedicate themselves to fight against the foes for their people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在地球未來,人類大量排放廢氣製造垃圾,使到地球迎來沙化期。動植物變異產生地球新主人“沙蟲,而它們將人類逼到滅絕邊緣,倖存者只能尋找僅存的避難所“綠洲。一支由富商、科學家、保安隊長、機械師以及混混組..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In future earth, humans emit exhaust gas to produce waste, leading to earths desertification. Desert Bugs are mutated to cause human extinction and the last hope of the survivors is to find the oasis. A team made up of tycoons, scientists, security chiefs, engineers and gangsters embarks on a perilous journey in an armoured tank to find the oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,一代奇人關師爺行走江湖,巧遇狐妖鬧事。關師爺與狐妖鬥法,過程中認識了逢賭必輸的葉飛。此事過後,關師爺又巧妙化解了一樁青樓恩怨,為死去的冤者伸冤,卻再次與怪事纏身的葉飛相遇。之後二人攜手與妖怪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican period, demon catcher Guan meets Ye Fei, a gambler who always loses, when he fights against the fox demon. Guan meets the troubled Ye Fei again after he resolves a case involving innocent deaths in a brothel, and they team up to successfully fight against the demons and evil spirits with their wit and bravery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 老實刻板的理髮師杜常勇喪妻後獨自撫養女兒。他想女兒能繼承自己的理髮店,但女兒一心只想參加新秀比賽節目當明星。二人缺乏理解加上代溝,引發父女之間頻繁爭吵。在一次爭吵後,杜到天台勸女兒回家,父女兩突然被宇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Honest hairstylist Du Chang Rong, raises his daughter on his own and hopes that she will take over his salon. However his daughter dreams of becoming an artiste. In a fight between Du and his daughter on the roof, they accidentally got struck by lightning and discover that they have swapped identities after regaining consciousness!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武周時期,生活在洛陽洛河水兩端但不同出生的兩個少女意外被捲入懸案之中。一位是金吾衛隊長的女兒趙青青,另一位是生於市井底層的女孩小騙子。她們一同遭遇在洛陽城內一連串匪夷所思的離奇案件,二人組成了臨時搭檔..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Zhou dynasty, two girls living in two ends of the Luo He River come from diverse backgrounds - one is a captains daughter and another is a common swindler - and they encounter a series of mysterious events in Luo Yang City. Both team up to investigate a series of bizarre cases, to uphold justice and to maintain order amidst a social upheaval.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一心想要去學習嶗山道法的少年王生,終獲高人指點,學成歸家,之後卻把師父“不可生邪念的教誨丟在腦後,學了點法術便打算用來行竊。隅然王解開了自己身世之謎,又經過幾番歷練才終於開悟,決定用屬於自己的方式來..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Wang Sheng aspires to learn Laoshan Taoism skills. Under the tutelage of his master, Wang acquires the skills but succumbs to greed, forsaking the masters teachings of Think No Evil. As Wang finds out about his own identity, his epiphany sparks enlightenment, prompting him to forge his unique path in vanquishing the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對綁匪誤將刑警丁偉女友,蘇雅婷綁架。本來是一場精心設計的綁架事件,卻陰差陽錯鬧出驚天命案。丁偉錯失摯愛,決心抓住兇手,千里追兇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Ding Weis girlfriend, Su Ya Ting, is mistakenly kidnapped. The plot takes a dark turn when she is brutally murdered. Devastated by the loss, Ding dedicates himself to the task of capturing the murderer, putting in relentless efforts to seek justice for his beloved.

epg.programme_title_tc: 狄仁傑探案之天煞孤鸞
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大婚當日,新娘在婚房內連殺四人,當眾否認自己是兇手後剖腹自盡。雖然新娘是最大嫌疑,但鄉民卻不約而同地認為真兇是一個身形柔弱的少女,就連少女本人也自願認罪,認為自己是“天煞孤星,命格剋親近之人。隨著狄..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On her wedding day, a bride is discovered to have killed four people before taking her own life. However, the villagers accuse a weak girl of the crime, and she herself pleads guilty due to her belief of being a lone star. As Detective Dee investigates the case, he uncovers the truth behind the mysterious murder and unveils a deadly conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝崇禎末年,正派與魔教勢不兩立互有爭鬥。白髮魔女練霓裳因此陷入一場江湖的腥風血雨當中,內裡更蘊含著重大陰謀。錦衣衛常安奉命暗中調查白髮魔女練霓裳,在追查的道路上,常安對練霓裳產生了莫名的情愫,要為練..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝崇禎末年,正派與魔教勢不兩立互有爭鬥。白髮魔女練霓裳因此陷入一場江湖的腥風血雨當中,內裡更蘊含著重大陰謀。錦衣衛常安奉命暗中調查白髮魔女練霓裳,在追查的道路上,常安對練霓裳產生了莫名的情愫,要為練..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

epg.programme_title_en: The Whirlwind of Sword and Fairy
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 百年前,仙劍門祖師爺張掌門與異人首領幽皇大戰七天七夜,最終打敗幽皇,並將異人族兵器「九黎」封印。百年後,仙劍門弟子張之霖成為新掌門。此時發現鎮上女人離奇失蹤,原來是幽皇吸食女人精魄練就神功。仙劍門布下..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 100 years ago, Master Zhang triumphed over Inhuman clan leader, Emperor Yu, in a fierce 7-day duel and sealed their weapons after that. A century later, Zhangs disciple, Lin, assumes leadership and discovers that the spirits of the vanished women are devoured by Emperor Yu for boosting his power. The war between good and evil has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 元朝末年,一個名為修羅幕主的神秘組織聲稱擁有武林至寶八極玄盒。他們邀請了頂尖的武林高手參加武林大會,事實上想用秘製毒藥控制他們為組織效力。太極宗師張三豐為要揭露組織的陰謀參加了武林大會,最終解開了八極..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the late Yuan dynasty, a secret gang invites top martial arts masters to an event to showcase a martial arts treasure, with an intention to drug the masters so that they fall under their control and can serve the gang. Tai Chi master Zhang San Feng attends the event to uncover their plot and successfully destroys the evil gang in the end.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雷霆安保公司的幽靈小隊,由林森帶領隊友執行解救女科學家南茜的任務。眾人救南後在撤離時見到一名小孩被關在籠裡,趕去營救,卻聽到槍響,之後全軍覆沒。於偉剛寫下小說“幽靈狙擊的一段,跟著一聲槍響,被擊中頭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Shen leads the insurance company’s ghost team to save a scientist. During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靈蛇山白蛇與青蛇姊妹潛心修煉,某日白蛇遇險,幸得上山尋藥的許仙搭救,兩人之後一心相戀。然而人妖殊途,許仙被迫離開白蛇。陰司大妖王下令追捕白蛇。白蛇生命垂危卻將千年修行給了許仙,許仙自取心臟救回白蛇後自..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: White Snake and Green Snake devote themselves to attain immortality in a mountain. Xu Xian save White Snake one day and they fall in love. With demons and the underworld against them, both lovers sacrifice themselves to save the other. A hundred years later, White Snake give up on becoming an immortal and returned to the mortal world to find Xu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三國時期,一代名將關羽在麥城之戰被吳國將軍潘璋所殺,青龍偃月刀也被奪走。兩年後蜀國君主劉備親征為關羽報仇,任命關羽之子關興組成小隊,秘密執行破壞吳軍水寨防禦中樞的任務。關興突破重重險阻,最終與殺父仇人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Pan Zhang of the Wus killed General Guan Yu and took away his Green Dragon Crescent Blade. Two years later, Emperor Liu Bei brings an army led by Guan Xing, the son of Guan Yu, to attack Wus waterfront defence. Guan Xing overcomes all challenges and fights against General Pan Zhang to avenge his fathers death, and reclaims the blade.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太平洋的某處孤島上建立了一座沒有法律限製的「無罪之城」,眾多犯罪分子慕名前往,以求庇護。國際特種兵唐柯在無罪之城執行任務時不幸落入索蘭的圈套,逃生時發現自己體內被注射毒劑,生命只剩下幾小時。面對妻子被..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Innocent City is built on an isolated island with no laws set in place and many criminals go there for shelter. Tang, of the special forces, is trapped by Solan during his mission, and though he escapes, he is poisoned and has few hours to live. As Solan also kills Tang’s wife and kidnaps his daughter, Tang embarks on a road to revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐德宗元年,道士預言黑蛟即將面世危害百姓。這日呂姓書生坐船東渡去找白瑛退婚,到達後發現白的父親失蹤,白也被傀儡化,而他亦遭到襲擊。書生逃脫後,遇到太白金星被告知他是被打入凡間的呂洞賓,前世今生黑蛟都是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Taoist prophecy foretells that the rise of Hei Jiao will threaten the world. As Scholar Lu Dongbin is on his way to end his marriage engagement to Bai, he finds her father missing and Bai possessed. As Lu learns about his immortal identity, he realizes that the encounter with Bai and the incidents that happened are all part of his destiny.

epg.programme_title_tc: 津沽奇譚1: 暗城殺機
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,津沽城命案接連發生,警局束手無策。一向以風水破案的段宇豪和祁威被要求調查此案以戴罪立功,免除之前的懲罰,但在找線索的同時,二人卻被一步步地推向多年前發生的羅剎鳥連環殺人案。段宇豪與祁..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In crime-ridden Jin Gu City, the police are unable to solve the murder cases. Duan Yu Hao and Qi Wei are assigned to investigate the cases through fortune-telling. In the process, a murder case that happened years ago is brought to their attention, and they vow to uncover the truth and find the murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張宸是軍事戰術教官,經常輾轉於世界各地為安保公司做戰術培訓。一次意外中,張被捲入一宗謀殺案,成了當地的通緝犯。張被迫逃亡,並在同伴初五的幫助下找到了謀殺案倖存者黛米。三人相互配合,開始著手調查,在槍林..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Military instructor Zhang Zhen accidentally gets involved in a murder and becomes the suspect. He is forced to flee and with the help of his companion, Zhang finds the sole survivor of the murder. The trio launches an investigation and strives to uncover the truth, which seems to be connected to a human smuggling gang and a military organization.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上古時期,魔族首領蚩尤擾亂天庭,最終被打回原形,天尊把他貶為凡人,及賜給他仁慈的心。數年後,蚩尤體內的魔性被別有用心的人喚醒,他便前往昆侖尋求解封方法。蚩尤途中結識了火焰山公主葉瀟瀟,二人情愫漸生,而..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in ancient times, leader of the demon tribe, Chi You, causes chaos in heaven and is demoted to become a kind human. When Chi Yous evil power awakens years later, he find ways to break his seal in Kun Lun, where he meets a princess and fall in love. Through perilous trials, Chi You and the princess unravel the truth behind a conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在無人區的荒野裡正發生著一場驚險的生死追蹤。少年堇言意外拍下了盜獵者襲擊警方的場面,不幸被歹徒發現後擊傷了堇。他忍耐著疼痛一路逃走,其後這幫人還挾持堇的姐姐樸雨。兩姐弟在無人區裡奮力逃走,憑藉著堅強意..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fatal pursuit happens in a no mans land. Young Jin Yan accidentally captures the scene of a poacher attacking a cop, and the villains attack and injure him when they discover his act. As Jin tries to escape, they kidnap his sister as well. Jin and his sister must strive to escape from the villains and bring them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北魏年間,新君登基,時局未穩,遊牧民族柔然對魏國虎視眈眈。為牽制柔然,大魏公主和親北涼,不料卻被柔然猛將綿爾圖擄走。綿挾持公主,要魏國在兩日內交出十座城池為贖金。魏國將軍花木蘭臨危受命,更啟用死囚慕容..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Northern Wei empire faces raids from the nomadic Rou Ran tribe. The princess of Wei is kidnapped by a Rou Ran general, who demands ten cities as ransom. Weis General Mulan forms a special task force to rescue the princess and a fatal battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以前的扶風城晚上花燈特別閃耀,尤如白天,然而現在卻被黑暗籠罩,更流傳著“點燈殺人的傳說,以致城中百姓晚上也不敢點燈。溫寧到城後,發現了很多反常之處,後來更遇到藍氏子弟藍思追,倆人為了還百姓一個太平安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lanterns once illuminated Fu Feng City at night, but it is now shrouded in darkness as there is a rumor that people will get killed when their lights are on. When Wen Ning discovers anomalies in this situation, he joins forces with Nan Si Zhui to find the real culprit behind and finally restore peace and harmony to the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毒梟塚虎在十五年前派人追殺梅姨,當時林郎與林峰親眼目睹母親梅姨被殺害,為躲避殺手追殺,郎與峰分頭走散,但郎之後音訊全無,而峰成為緝毒員警。在中國邊境滇市的掃毒行動中,峰發現毒梟郎哥的母親也是被塚虎殺害..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Lang and Lin Feng witness their mothers murder by the drug dealer Tiger fifteen years ago. They separated in their escape and Feng becomes a narcotics police officer while Lang disappears. In an operation, Feng discovers that Tiger has also killed the mother of a drug boss, Lang. Is Lang his brother? Can Feng arrest the drug dealers?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球太空基地捕捉到一組來自外太空的神秘訊號,為探尋外星文明,艦長“原帶領船員駕駛著星際探索飛船“深空號駛向宇宙,但不久飛船卻神秘失蹤。150年後,深空號突然出現,船上只剩下一名女科學家“尹。在她..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Yuan and his crew explore the mysteries of outer space after the Space Centre detects extraterrestrial signals. However, the spacecraft vanishes after lift-off. 150 years later, the spacecraft reappears, harbouring a female scientist. The secret of outer space is unveiled through her recollection of the crew’s peculiar experience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前海外某安保公司的精英隊員韓彬,在一次保護任務時失敗,從此銷聲匿跡,頹廢終日。老拍檔希望韓能重新振作,在他極力邀請下,韓答應保護明星蘇曉琪前往東南亞某國拍攝節目。一路上,韓化解了多次威脅曉琪生命安全的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Former elite security guard Han Bin vanishes after a failed escort mission and wallows in self pity. His partner encourages Han to be his former self by escorting an actress to Southeast Asia to film a show. On the way, Han successfully deals with threats to the actress life, but realizes in the end that he is the one the evil gang has targeted!

epg.programme_title_en: Monkey King: The One and Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孫悟空在西天取經的路上,總是被師父唐僧質疑胡亂殺生,因此導致師徒之間產生隔閡。有一天,他們遇到了狐貍小七,而小七哥哥為了延續小七的性命,便起了要吃唐僧肉來救小七的念頭。哥哥開始用詭計動搖他們的信念,令..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Monkey King clashes with Monk Tang on their quest for Buddhist Sutras as Tang suspects Monkey of taking lives. One day, they meet Foxy Seven, whose brother plans to eat Monk Tang to save his life. Foxy Sevens brother stirs up conflicts between Monk and Monkey, but through trials and tribulations, they reconcile and continue their journey.

epg.programme_title_en: Monkey King: The One and Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孫悟空在西天取經的路上,總是被師父唐僧質疑胡亂殺生,因此導致師徒之間產生隔閡。有一天,他們遇到了狐貍小七,而小七哥哥為了延續小七的性命,便起了要吃唐僧肉來救小七的念頭。哥哥開始用詭計動搖他們的信念,令..

One day, they meet Foxy Seven, whose brother plans to eat Monk Tang to save his life. Foxy Sevens brother stirs up conflicts between Monk and Monkey, but through trials and tribulations, they reconcile and continue their journey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國員警王之章的兒子因鴉片而亡。他痛恨舊社會犯罪橫行,封建思想荼毒百姓,因此偽裝成道士潛入當地商人陳老爺家調查鴉片走私案件,期間卻遇到連環殺人事件。身為員警的王之章為了職責及為兒子報仇,誓要抓住兇手,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Policeman Wang hates crime in the city and the feudalism that lead to his sons death by opium. Disguised as a Taoist priest, he investigates opium smuggling in a merchants home and uncovers a series of murders. Driven by duty and revenge, Wang vows to find the murderer, destroy the stored opium and restore peace in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天真無邪的少女清澄,為了給家人報仇,被訓練成冷血殺手。數度殺人後,她決定放下怨念,在安樂寨度過平靜的餘生,也在那裡結識了樂於助人的阿邦,與他結了婚。正當清澄隱藏武功平淡過活時,江湖風雲無奈又起。為了維..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young and innocent Qing Cheng is trained to become a ruthless killer to seek vengeance for her family. After killing many, she decides to let go of her resentment and seeks refuge in a remote village, where she meets Bang and marries him. As social upheaval erupts, Qing has to step up again to protect the village and restore peace.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個佛與魔較量的故事。為阻止上古妖魔羅剎降世,將世間顛覆成萬劫不復的寒冰煉獄,少林寺弟子慧海踏上了尋找降龍羅漢之旅。青梅竹馬的上官靈素始終陪伴守護慧海,不畏困難,幫助慧海破除心魔,參透少林精神,最終憑..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a battle between Buddha and Devil, Shaolin disciple Hui Hai embarks on a journey to find Luo Han to stop the demon from turning the world upside down. Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.

epg.programme_title_tc: 龍棺古墓: 西夏狼王
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀10年代初,以劉錦州為首的“生旦淨醜四位戲子,為了營救在西夏狼王墓失蹤的恩師袁震,不得不踏上兇險萬分的探墓尋人之旅。在墓穴中一行人經歷了種種危機和生離死別,在過程中發現了古墓的神秘寶物及師父不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the early 1910s, four performers embark on a perilous journey to an ancient tomb in search of their missing master. Inside the tomb, they encounter various difficulties and experience life and death. In the process, they also discover a mysterious treasure in the tomb and unveils their masters secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緝毒精英的閆鵬在追捕毒販赤那時,同事兼好友阿古拉犧牲於毒販手中。之後鵬來到阿古拉家照顧他的家人,卻不料碰上真正的赤那到來,要阿古拉父親帶路,幫他逃離邊境。鵬隨後才知道,先前被他消滅的毒販竟然是赤那的孿..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agula, a friend and coworker of Narcotic agent Yan, is killed by the drug dealer Chi Na. While Yan takes care of Agulas family, he encounters Chi Na who wants to flee the country with the help of Agulas father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝末年,大明水師軍官林嘯為了阻止東瀛倭寇得到“神機武庫,及要找回失蹤的戰友陸老大,而接受了水師參將向吉的徵召,踏上兇險的尋寶之路。航行中,神秘海怪族羣與倭寇均同時盯上了林的船。他必須與同伴合力與倭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To stop the Japanese pirates and find his missing friend, the Ming dynasty Marine Officer Lin Xiao joins the Marine General to embark on a treasure hunt. On the way, they encounter a mysterious sea monster as well as the pirates. Lin must join forces with the marine team to battle against them and accomplish their mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期上海,怪物獵人宇文預測到上豪大飯店有怪獸出現,而當怪獸現身襲擊表演的花旦顧青時,宇文英雄救美,打斷富少警探天明的公開表白。之後三人被捲入了一系列的奇怪案件,在調查過程中,所有線索都指向一個塵封..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican time in Shanghai, monster hunter Yu saves an actress in a play from a monsters attack, at the same time interrupting a cops love confession for her. As the trio gets involved in a series of mysterious cases, they find out that the cases are related to a legend about a giant monster who will soon be returning to the world...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋末年,國家陷入內憂外患的局面。狄族聯合魔教,妄想踏平中原稱霸江湖,危難之際,無極派大弟子張君寶又名張三豐挺身而出,協助朝廷擊退敵軍,卻不料師門慘遭魔教血洗,死傷慘重。為了振興門派,保衛家園,張毅然..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tribe Di join forces with the Demon Cult to rule the martial arts world. Zhang San Feng, a disciple of Wu Ji Clan, helps the government to fight the rebels but this results in his clan suffering heavy casualties. To save his clan and his homeland, Zhang sets out to destroy the Demon Cult but gets entangled in another conspiracy in the process.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特警大隊狙擊手張遠和觀察手胡兵在一次行動中,意外將人質李翔打傷致癱瘓。張之後離開特警大隊,與李成為搭檔。三年後,張根據一次調查線索潛入一家制毒工廠,卻發現前隊友胡是工廠負責人。與此同時,張剛巧碰上另一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: SWAT sniper Zhang and his spotter Hu accidentally paralyzed the hostage Li Xiang in an operation. Zhang left the team after and partnered with Li. Three years later, Zhang infiltrates a drug lab in an investigation, only to discover that it is operated by his former teammate Hu. When a drug gang raids the lab, Zhang is trapped in the fierce battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年的龍雲鎮,相傳鎮子發現寶藏後逐漸怪事不斷,接連出現少女家中被殺。同時,寶藏消息也招來各路心懷不軌的“江湖術士紛紛前來尋寶。巡捕隊的林隊長迫於鎮長壓力,決定聯手死刑犯計連營一起找出真凶及解開背..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of mysterious incidents happen when treasure is discovered in Long Yun Town, including killings of girls. As ill-intentioned martial artists arrive to uncover the treasure, Cop Lin, assigned by the mayor, teams up with a death row inmate to identify the murderer and uncover the truth, so as to safeguard the town and its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狐族女君九尾不幸落入梅山七怪老大猿猴精袁洪之手,陰差陽錯被姜子牙所救,卻被姜斬斷一條尾巴。九尾走投無路在女媧娘娘的指點下附身在冀州候蘇護的女兒蘇妲己身上。不久,紂王攻打冀州,妲己被俘,及後紂王娶了妲己..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nine-tailed Fox is caught by the seven monkey monster in Mount Mei. Jiang Zi Ya inadvertently saves Nine-tailed Fox but cuts off one of her tails, making her so desperate that she possesses the body of Da Ji. Shortly after, Emperor Shang invades Ji Zhou and kidnaps Da Ji, who later becomes Empress Shang and causes chaos throughout the realm.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十年前,身為救援隊隊長的張一凡帶著家人去度假,不料突發遇到颱風,張的兒子也意外在山崩中喪生。兒子的死讓他變得神經質,妻子也提出離婚。張本想挽回家庭,不料又一場颱風來襲,妻子被颱風所困,女兒又被人綁架。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 10 years ago, rescue team leader Zhang suffered the loss of his son in a landslide during a typhoon. His anguish leads to his wifes request for divorce. While Zhang tries to reconcile with his family, another typhoon strikes. His wife is trapped and their daughter is kidnapped. Facing such difficulties, Zhang must save his wife and daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,生物研究所得知在沙海有異變生物,於是派出探索小隊前往調查,但前去的隊員幾乎全部被滅,剩下劉夢西和夏萱帶著生物樣本逃離,過程非常危險,幸得獲沙丘鎮柳纓所救。原來沙漠出現異獸,居民被迫在地底生活..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Institute of Biology assigns a team to investigate the mutants in a desert, but the whole team is nearly wiped out. Luckily, two researchers escape with the mutants samples. As the residents in the desert are forced to live underground to avoid threats by the mutants, the team must beat the mutants for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐門有一秘寶“洞天儀,可以提前預知惡人名錄。唐門會在此人作惡之前將其殺掉來維護天下太平。一天,唐門掌門唐無煙之名竟也出現於洞天儀之上,無煙被迫逃走,遇到善良小賊楚晨。在其幫助下,她決心殺回唐門尋找真..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Within the Tang Sect lies a treasure that will unveil names of future villains, who the Sect will kill before they can commit their evil acts. When Sect leader Yans name surfaces, she is forced to flee but meets a compassionate thief, Chu. Together they return to the Tang Sect and uncover the truth behind the conspiracy to prove her innocence.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 初任上海警察隊長的陳虎接到一樁命案,軍政部部長之子何滿君離奇死亡。何是聖馬丁高中的一名學生,為了獲得破案信息,陳喬裝學生混入學校。他一邊查案,一邊與各方勢力展開較量,而何之死迷霧重重,一個又一個嫌疑人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The son of a minister is mysteriously killed. The newly appointed police inspector Chen Fu, goes undercover as a secondary student to investigate the case. As he carries on investigation in the school, Chen encounters different potential suspects, making the case more mysterious. What is the cause of the murder and who is the killer?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武周時期,禦史中丞胡顯德一家被殺,武則天派狄仁傑前往調查。狄調查發現,原本老實本分的胡離奇般參與了一場大案,此案可能是一宗案中案。在查案過程中,狄不斷遇見各種詭異事件,更有陰兵索命的傳言,案件一籌莫展..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Di Ren Jie is assigned by Empress Wu to investigate the massacre of Minister Hus family. In the process, he uncovers Hus involvement in a criminal case and encounters spooky incidents, as well as rumours of vengeful killing by hell guards. Di delves into the heart of the perplexing mystery, unravelling the truth behind it.

One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 霍元甲年少氣盛,認為武術為重。為了在天津的武館立足,他連續打敗了七家武館,在對戰大刀王五的徒弟幽蘭時,卻遭到朝廷勢力袁庭山的陷害。與此同時,霍負責護送維新首領譚先生回京城。在這次驚心動魄的任務中,他逐..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Huo Yuan Jia loves marital arts. He defeats seven martial arts school masters to establish himself in Tianjin, but is set up by a court official during a tournament. When Huo escorts a revolutionary leader to the capital, he finally understands that the country and its people are the ultimate purpose for practising martial arts.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,發丘一脈的傳人張聞風為了尋找父親失蹤真相,及阻止境外惡勢力盜取不死神樹,與夥伴踏上兇險萬分的古墓之旅,但他們卻誤闖誤撞進入了崑崙山,一個藏有 百神 的上古神跡崑崙墟。然而令張意想不到的是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zheng Min Feng embarks on a thrilling journey with his friend to an ancient tomb to find his missing father and protect the immortal tree. However, they mistakenly go to Mount Kwun Lun, the sacred site with One Hundred Gods. Amidst the creepy legend and perilous journey, they must confront the enigmatic depths of the human heart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一列載著淘金夢開往上海的列車突然脫軌墜崖。吳天等一行人倖免於難,卻遭到蜈蚣攻擊。隨後他們逃進了一個怪異村莊,而古怪的村長對這幫各懷鬼胎的倖存者起了殺心。突然成群蜈蚣傾巢而出,在村中大開殺戒。吳天等..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A train carrying gold rushers derails and falls off the cliff. Wu and other passengers survive, but are attacked by centipedes. Subsequently, they escape to a village. With the village head trying to kill them and the centipedes attacking at the same time, can Wu and other passengers escape the disaster? What is the secret of the village head?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 胡八一與王胖子及大金牙在古蘭郡遇到Shirley楊,得知孫教授被困於龍嶺迷窟。四人一起進入迷窟尋找教授,出來後胡和王身上長出眼球狀的紅斑,根據Shirley外公的筆記,解藥雮塵珠有可能藏在黑水城的通天..

According to the notes written by Shirleys grandfather, the antidotes may be hidden at Tong Tian Buddhist Temple, so the four of them set off on a challenging journey for the cure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清乾隆年間,紅花會老舵主于萬亭病逝,命其義子陳家洛受命接任掌門之位。之後紅花會多個分舵遭受襲擊,而四當家文泰來下落不明。陳與消息靈通的玉如意達成交易,兩人與幾位當家合作營救文。其後陳發現文的失蹤可能是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Qing dynasty, Chen Jia Luo is appointed as the new leader of Red Flower Society. Thereafter, the societys members face attacks and one of their branch leaders, Wen, goes missing. As Chen teams up with Yu to rescue Wen, he uncovers a connection between Wen’s disappearance and King Fus treasure. Meanwhile, Yus real identity also surfaces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 弟弟杜家豪在上水鎮被水猴子殘殺,民國女法醫清伶為了探尋真相便前往上水鎮探尋原因。在這詭異的村莊,關於水猴子復仇的“詛咒接二連三發生。清伶携槍勇闖水怪禁地黑木林,而她力憑科學文明剷除水猴子的封建迷信,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Forensic pathologist Qing investigates her brothers murder by the water monkeys in a town where the curse of a vengeful monkey ensues. Armed with a gun, Qing ventures to the forbidden land of Water Monster and debunks superstitions with scientific facts, ultimately leading the villagers to fight against the evil forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 趙子龍在常山歸隱七年後,因戰亂變故流落到鄴城與劉備及趙雲重逢。趙子龍終究被劉備的仁義所折服,在劉備與眾人的鼓勵及殘酷現實的鞭策之下,逐漸找回自我與理想,再次號召眾兄弟並肩作戰,最終在長阪坡大敗敵軍,成..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hiding in Mount Zhang for seven years,  Zhao Zi Long reunites with Liu Bei and Zhao Yun. Persuaded by Lius righteousness, Zhao rediscovers his aspirations and rallies his comrades to battle their enemies at Chang Ban Slope. He eventually defeats the enemies and emerges as the Great General of the Han Dynasty.

epg.programme_title_tc: 大法醫宋慈系列之偷梁換柱
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋慈在建甯縣遇到知縣大人誤判吳蜚卿案,為了幫助吳洗脫冤屈找出真相,宋必須在兩天之內抓住真凶。根據紙扇上的神秘痕跡、消失不見的兇器、宋在面對種種疑點,終於找出了與兇手有關的蛛絲馬跡。此時,突然出現的一份..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tasked with absolving Wus wrongful conviction, Song Ci races against time to unveil the real culprit within two days. With the enigmatic clues on a paper fan and a missing weapon, Song Ci draws closer to finding the culprit. However, an indictment hiding a conspiracy suddenly appears, leaving Song Ci speechless...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在東北下鄉的知識青年胡八一等人為了救助患病的村民畫眉,聯合獵人趙叔前去森林雪人熊洞採集解藥。然而,一夥人突然遭到熊的攻擊,只好逃入黃鼠狼地下洞穴。他們目睹了那裡發生的奇怪事情和出現幻覺。胡等人破除迷信..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Hu Ba and hunter Zhao venture to a bear-guarded cave to find an antidote to cure a sick villager. Attacked by the bear, they take refuge in a weasels cave where they encounter bizarre incidents and illusions. After Hu and Zhao dispelled the superstition trap and uncovered the true culprit, they successfully escape and rescue the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少林習武歸來的方世玉,本打算過平常人的生活,但剛回到家鄉肇慶便牽扯到一樁貪腐案中。朝廷貪官的爪牙鄂爾多帶隊殺人滅口並企圖銷毀證據,方世玉雖面對好友周蓉的慘死,母親被擒為人質,但卻面無懼色,決意反抗到底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Having mastered the Shaolin martial arts, Fang Shi Yu yearns for a tranquil existence back home but becomes entangled in a corruption scandal. The governors henchman assigns a squad to eliminate witnesses and erase all evidence. Despite facing his best friends death and his mothers captivity, Fang vows to fight against the forces of evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Pei of the Water Cult is trapped by Kong in a seal as he tries to kill to find the treasure. Kong leaves with an orphan Fang and 20 years later, Pei unseals himself to find the treasure again and kills Kong. As Fang learns the Fire skills from his master Kong, he vows to avenge his death but then discovers his ties to the Water Cult.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The newly completed Luo Yang Palace is set to fire by the Fire Dragon, resulting in the carpenters being missing or dead. Detective Dee is tasked to investigate the case. He finds the cases key person, demolishes a secret base with his best friend Liu, and kills the Fire Dragon, vowing to uncover the truth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 老段多年前因涉嫌一樁案件入獄,而剛出獄的他為搞清當年真相,決定要謀劃一場大騙局。怎料此行動卻捲入了他與三個前妻所生的三個性格不同的孩子。一家四口一邊聯手抗敵,一邊互相搞破壞,而這一切都逐漸走向失控及不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Released from jail after an alleged offence, Lao Duan plans a scam to uncover the truth behind the past happenings. His three kids, each of distinct character, get involved in the plan. The family join hands to defeat the enemy, but at the same time, also making troubles for themselves.  As the situation spirals, the ending ia anyones guess.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 未來世界,人工智慧高速發展,由程非掌控的地下科研組織,為牟取暴利研製激發異能人的晶片。由於一次變故,程下令清除所有實驗者,導致千鶴母親犧牲,而逃出生天的千鶴為替母親報仇,以身涉險對抗惡勢力,在危急關頭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In an AI-driven world, the underground institute has developed chips which can activate supernatural power for profiteering. An accident occurs and killed Qian Hes mother. Qian He vows to avenge her mothers death and fight against the villains after provoking her supernatural power, finally unveiling the institutes hidden secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在香港讀書的少年葉問,意外卷入英國斯塔克集團綁架中國婦女走私到海外的人口販賣案中。葉挺身而出怒打綁匪解救出一批被拐的女子,不料遭到激烈報覆,更連累了身邊的朋友。葉問開始反思,知道個人力量不足夠對抗斯塔..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Ip Man battles a British kidnapping gang involved in trafficking Chinese women. As he fights to rescue the captives, he becomes a target of revenge, even endangering his friends. Recognizing his limits, Ip Man works with the patriots to expose the gang’s thrilling conspiracy.

epg.programme_title_en: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八年前,邪惡的黑羽會潛入了老邪神西城勇的地盤,盜走了修羅面具,而利用修羅面具放出當時只是個嬰兒的魔神。老邪神為了魔神日後不作惡收養了嬰兒,教他好好做人,成為小邪神。小邪神最後控制了面具的力量成為老邪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緝毒隊成員泰樺、老米、阿峰和阿棠共同參與抓捕毒梟的行動。然而,因黑警洩密,阿峰遇難,上司犧牲,阿棠也隨之消失。為了揭開真相,泰樺與老米在剿滅毒梟的過程中,必須在忠誠與背叛之間掙扎。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Narcotics squad members—Tai Hua, Lao Mi, Ah Feng, and Ah Tang—are involved in arresting a drug lord. However, a betrayal within the police leads to the deaths of Ah Feng and his superior, while Ah Tang vanishes. As Tai Hua and Lao Mi uncover the truth, they find themselves torn between loyalty and betrayal in their fight against the drug cartel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the tragic loss of his lover, Neua learns Monkey Muay Thai and vows to avenge her death. His lover’s sister, who practises Chinese Kung Fu, initially suspects Neua of being responsible, but later discovers that her sister was killed by an organised crime ring. Together, they join forces to uphold justice and seek vengeance.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After Fong Sai-Yuk’s adoptive father is murdered by traitors of the Red Flower Society, he vows to hunt them down and avenge his death. Driven by grief and loyalty, he rises against the conspirators in a ruthless fight for justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Extreme Ends是個動作冒險真人秀節目,邀請四位名人及其特別嘉賓一同體驗香港的多元魅力!讓我們跟隨印尼名模 Patricia 和 Chika 探索這座城市的隱秘寶藏和知名地標,沉浸在強烈對比的..

Join Indonesian famous models Patricia and Chika as they explore the citys hidden gems and vibrant scenes, immersing themselves in amazing contrasts and trendy vibes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the world is plunged into eternal darkness, adventurer Xiao Wu sets out to find a sealed ancient book that controls the universe. Betrayed by ruthless factions, he discovers he is a reincarnated magical page bound by an ancient love. Awakening his hidden powers, he battles evil to restore light and fulfil his destiny.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Erin,一名飽受創傷與怒火困擾的女子,前往偏遠莊園探訪男友的家人,卻發現對方竟是操控血腥交易的邪教。當她被擄並成為獵物時,壓抑已久的怒火徹底爆發,反轉局勢,展開一場殘酷的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Erin, a troubled young woman with trauma and anger, travels to a remote estate to meet her boyfriend’s family. The visit turns into a nightmare when she discovers they are part of a blood cult. Abducted and marked for harvest, Erin unleashes a deadly rage, turning the hunt into a brutal fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.programme_title_tc: Blood Hunters: Rise of the Hybrids
epg.programme_title_en: Blood Hunters: Rise of the Hybri
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Gabriella的家人慘死於混血怪物之手。為了復仇,她投身血獵手的行列,毅然踏上獵殺之途。與同伴並肩,向冷血的地下軍權組織宣戰—一場腥風血雨的亡命激鬥就此展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gabriella is driven by vengeance after a hybrid monster slaughters her family. On her quest, she joins a squad of Blood Hunters and together they wage war against ruthless underworld warlords, igniting a brutal showdown.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1917年,少年葉問初到香港求學。英文演講比賽當天,學校發生一宗驚天綁架案,全校同學都被挾持。面對眼前的危機,葉問挺身而出,發現綁匪竟然是自己的師父和好兄弟。少年葉問在危機時刻可否打敗綁匪,從而伸張正..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team’s downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Novak Djokovic is excluded from the 2022 Australian Open, the savage attack which scuppered the career of Monica Seles and the fall of Maria Sharapova.

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 和朱爾茲在捕獵行動中追上曼茲族群,和他一起拍攝一場野狗捕獵大戰;在卡庫裡族群冒著巨大的風險等待雨季到來時,留意獵豹和鬣狗的活動.與一隻歸來的鶴群公犬一起進行一次史詩般的狩獵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Film a wild dog hunt with Julz as he catches up with the Manzi pack at a kill, and watch for leopards and hyenas as the Kakuli pack takes great risks while waiting for the rains to come. Go on an epic hunt with a returning male of the Stork Colony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是「黃金森林」的故事,坐落在非洲西南海岸的大片海帶.由大西洋深處的營養物質所養育,滋潤著四個不同的世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is the story of the Golden Forest, the vast expanses of kelp that lines Africas southwestern shore. Fed by an upwelling of nutrients from deep in the Atlantic, the kelp forest nurtures four distinct worlds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在大自然中,年幼的動物大部分時間都在玩耍.從喜歡追逐的貓,到可以解決謎題的黑猩猩.新研究表明遊戲幾乎是動物學習的全部核心,它不僅是樂趣和遊戲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the ways that animals use play, including young gibbons in Thailand that practice falling from branches, elderly macaques that preserve their brains with playtime, and games that sharpen the profound intelligence of African elephants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世界各地的動物會玩各種團體遊戲,從玩扯大纜的年輕鬣狗,到喜歡混戰的淘氣猴子.但為甚麼有些動物需要跟同伴一起玩耍呢?遊戲的規則又是甚麼呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young hyenas compete in tug of war, mischievous parrots play at picking apart tourists cars, and Atlantic spotted dolphins enjoy sophisticated social games amid seaweed-all following specific rules that hone social bonds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 五月的每天,太陽如常升起.從漢波德企鵝到哥倫比亞雨林的猴子,再到太平洋邊緣的科隆群島奇異美洲鬣蜥,美洲熱帶地區的動物已經準備好抵抗酷熱.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow penguins, iguanas, tortoises, frogs and tamarins from Mexico to Peru, and as far west as the Galapagos Islands, as they live out their daily dramas, affected by the suns heat, looming predators and hazardous weather conditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏至影響亞洲動物,令越南獼猴進入涼快的水中,使鶴在寒冷的青藏高原上跳舞,並激發一種奇怪的魚出來散步.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how creatures from the Tibetan plateau, to the lush rainforests of Thailand, to Vietnams twisted mangroves, survive four extra hours of daylight once a year, searching for food, fighting for dominance and raising their families.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭的聖誕節只是夏天裡的一天.雖然標誌性的鷸鴕躲避陽光,但海豹,黃眼企鵝和海豚卻享受長時間日照下充裕的額外餵食時間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how one animal familys tragedy is anothers holiday dinner as New Zealands mainland and island creatures, including penguins, flightless birds, sea lions, and sharks, battle to feed and protect their young in this marine environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 印度次大陸的母親節象徵旱季於斯里蘭卡開始,同時於印度結束.對於一隻孟加拉虎媽媽來說,是時候訓練她的幼崽去狩獵了,而獅子和眼鏡蛇則忙於交配.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Find out which creatures survive and whose luck will run out as animal mothers and moms-to-be struggle with sweltering temperatures, lurking predators, mating season, and drought on a day that proves to be no holiday.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在這片小林地中,兩隻幼猴面臨一生中最艱難的日子.牠們要在世上找到一席之地時,必須瞭解哪些鄰居是盟友,哪些是敵人;誰值得信賴,誰應該避開.牠們會失去或得到朋友,這樣才算是林地的一份子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this small patch of woodland, two young monkeys face the toughest time of their lives. As they find their place in the world, they must learn which neighbors are allies, and which are foes. Who to trust, and who to avoid. They will suffer loss,...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚比亞的荒野是一個難以生存的地方.這裡許多動物都必須成群結隊來幫忙保衛領土,保護後代,覓食和對抗掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wilds of Zambia are a tough place to live. Here, many animals must come together in groups to help defend territory, protect offspring, find food and overcome predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每天在盧安瓜谷都會看到一具動物屍體.每一具都擁有導致牠們死亡的故事.在草原狩獵鑑證科中,我們調查已發現的3具屍體的死亡個案...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Everyday in the Luangwa Valley a carcass is sighted. Each body holds the story that lead them to their death. In Safari CSI we investigate what killed three carcasses that have been uncovered...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚比亞擁有三個非常特殊和不同的非洲伊甸園.位於低處又炎熱的是盧安瓜河谷,高處又乾旱的是柳瓦平原,而涼爽濕潤的是卡桑卡國家公園.這些特質由它們的所在和季節所塑造,每個地方都為選擇於那定居的野生動物提供獨特的東西.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zambia is home to three very special and different African Edens. The low, hot Luangwa River Valley, the high, dry Liuwa Plain and the cool, wet Kasanka National Park. Defined by the earth on which they sit and shaped by the seasons, each place of...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚比亞的盧安瓜谷是非洲最大和最可怕的巨人的家園,但真正讓它變得特別的是鳥類.這裡有超過400種不同的物種;每個都完美地適應利用所提供的每個機會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zambias Luangwa Valley is home to Africas biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here; each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪地土的盡頭,一個極具生命力的自然劇場正在眼前上演.從微小的蝴蝶到巨大的座頭鯨,他們都走在地球演化的最前線,透過不斷改變行為來適應千變萬化的生境,並幫助我們解開對這個藍色星球的種種謎團.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to the ends of the Earth, where a drama is unfolding in real time. Meet animals, from tiny butterflies to huge humpback whales, that are acting as sentinels, adapting their behaviour, and helping us unlock the riddles of our changing planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 散落在不同海洋上的島嶼,其多樣性超乎想像;演化亦在你眼前發生.從加拉帕戈斯群島走到南極洲,看看海獅,雀鳥,蟋蟀,猴子和其他野生動物,如何以驚人的適應力來應對氣候變化問題.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Find out why islands are like mini-Earths where evolution happens before your eyes. Journey from the Galápagos to Antarctica to see how sea lions, finches, crickets, monkeys and other wildlife are finding surprising solutions to climatic problems.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從撒哈拉到荒野,於極端環境中學習動物如何適應急速變化的氣候並掙扎求存.與黑猩猩一起在洞穴中避難,看看駱駝以特別技巧飲用鹽水,並傾聽斑胸草雀為蛋寶寶由唱的歌,了解歌聲如何讓幼雛變得細小.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world. Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smaller.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​追溯獅子從史前掠食者到現代統治者的崛起,隨著科學揭示塑造這位標誌性非洲獵手的戰鬥,聯繫和殘酷生存策略.沉浸在獅子社會的戲劇和高風險狩獵的情節中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trace the lions rise from prehistoric predator to modern ruler as science reveals the battles, bonds, and brutal survival strategies that have shaped this iconic African hunter. Get swept up in the drama of lion society and high-risk hunts.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在盧安瓜谷,強大的孟巴肯高獅群仍有17頭壯獅,但老化的雄性領導無以為繼.在北方,荷里活獅群中的六隻雌獅已經自給自足了三年,但沒有雄性與她們交配,可能導致族群滅絕.四名年輕流浪雄獅突然的造訪,似乎回應著荷里活獅群的祈禱.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the all-female Hollywood pride encounters the Nomads, a new pride of rival males, they may have found the answer to their mating dry spell. But they quickly realize that it will not be a happy encounter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在盧安瓜谷,荷里活獅群大難臨頭.流浪雄獅的侵襲使女族長阿華受了重傷.由於首領喪失能力,狩獵變得困難.在尋找獅子的過程中,阿森發現了一隻鬣狗幼崽,牠的母親去打獵時遺下牠.鬣狗與孟巴肯高獅群因爭奪一隻水牛的屍體而大打出手.彌敦收到驚喜:孟巴肯高獅群原來藏著更多的幼獅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hollywood pride reels after the Nomads brutal attack on their leader, Ava, leaves her desperately weak and unable to hunt. To add to her woes, her hungry pride start rejecting her. But without her, they struggle to bring down prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四頭流浪雄獅組成的暴力團,正尋找可接管的獅群.他們在盧安瓜河的西岸徘徊,並已跟北方的荷里活雌獅群大打一場,現正南下進入強大的孟巴肯高獅群的地盤.孟巴肯高的雌獅群的狩獵隊阻止他們接近,但她們的策略只能持續幾天.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The lions of the Nomad pride rampage deep into the heart of the MK prides territory, scattering its members and coming dangerously close to the five new MK cubs. Meanwhile, the Hollywoods are recovering, and Avas survival skills are still intact.

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當朱爾茲滿懷感情地向狗群道別時,天上下起了雨.他欣慰地看到正在捕獵珍珠雞的鸛群幼崽,卡庫裡幼崽在吃羚羊屍體,頑皮的曼茲群在圍攻一隻頑強的疣豬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome the rains as an emotional Julz says farewell to the dog packs. He discovers the Stork Colony pups hunting guinea fowl, and is heartened to find the Kakuli pups feeding on an antelope carcass. The playful Manzi pack corner a tough warthog.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位處非洲南部海岸的阿爾哥亞灣,是該大陸唯一的企鵝避難所.跟企鵝一起求生,牠們勇於接受難以容忍的因素,以建立一個不可能的海洋社區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The population of African penguins in Southern Africa is on the decline, but the charismatic species has found a stronghold on two islands in Algoa Bay. This is the story of the penguins daily struggle to raise families in an unforgiving and host...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 撐過嬰兒期是地球上幾乎所有物種的最大挑戰.在非洲荒野,生死的平衡很容易傾側,動物必須成長並迅速學習,才能度過生命的第一階段.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For the first few weeks of life, the world is a frightening place. Danger lurks around every corner. It pays to be alert. Whether predator or prey. Any day might be your last. The race is on to grow up fast- for even the largest animals are vulner...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 贊比亞的幼崽由成長至生育,皆面臨著巨大挑戰,每個教訓都意味著生死一線.牠們成年的過程需要技巧,力量,勇氣和大量的運氣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased - but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own. Some have months to grow-up; other have decades – but all, have lots to learn along t...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了把基因傳承給下一代,動物在一生中歷盡史詩式的鬥爭.只有最強壯和最有決心的才能覓得伴侶,為交配而戰,也只有最優秀的父母才能擁有讓幼崽存活的技能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For every species on earth the right to mate is the purpose of life. Passing on your genes to the next generation is every animals legacy. But its not easy, it can be a struggle to find a mate and then a fight to gain access. Only the strongest ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 作為歐洲最大的陸地哺乳類動物,也是陸上最後的野生牛犢.歐洲野牛曾漫遊大部分舊世界,但與大西洋另一側的近親不同,在20世紀初被捕獵至完全滅絕.只有通過雄心壯志的重建事業,現在才能再次在自然棲息地看到這些迷人的動物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to western Germany, where Europes largest mammals have returned to the landscape after being hunted to extinction in the early 20th century. Discover the challenges animals and humans face from the beasts reintroduction to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於德國北部心臟地帶,就近漢堡的施泰因胡德湖是德國的生物多樣性熱點.有著不同的棲息地,如沼澤地
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore a biodiversity hotspot in the heart of northern Germany, where biologists engineered the return of tree frogs, mink, Ferruginous ducks, and osprey. Discover how the area may become a paradise for many rare animals once considered extinct.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安達盧西亞混雜著各種極端棲息地.從荒涼的阿爾梅里亞地區到內華達山脈白雪皚皚的山頂,從莫雷納山脈乾涸的冬青樹林到加的斯附近朦朧的西班牙栓皮櫟和格拉拿達被灌木覆蓋的懸崖.在歷史洪流中,人類的定居和狩獵對這些地貌及其動物群產生了根本性的影響.時至今天,在安達盧西亞發現的許多動物已經找到了創新的生存策...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Investigate the animals that have been returned to this mosaic of extreme habitats in Spain. Then discover how small environmental changes can make big differences in the populations of many endangered species and give them a real chance to recover.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尼羅鱷和河馬是非洲兩種淡水兩棲類的表表者,在整個非洲大陸的水道,河流和湖泊中都有其蹤影,亦包括南非夸祖魯納塔爾省的壯麗荒野.這兩個物種共存數千年,以不同的方式進化成依水而生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africas amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在哥倫比亞中心的熱帶雨林中長大,一隻年輕的捲尾猴必須掌握牠的攀爬技巧,學習如何尋找食物,又要學會區分敵友.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Growing up in the rainforests in the heart of Colombia, a young capuchin monkey has to master his climbing skills, learn how to find food and learn to distinguish friend from foe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚比亞的卡桑卡國家公園是一個不尋常狒狒種類的家園.狒狒有點背棄了通常與這些大型猴子相關的主導地位的攻擊性,並開展更和平的生活.與牠們生活的是一支專門的研究團隊,他們的任務是揭示這些狒狒的秘密,並瞭解是什麼讓牠們變成這樣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From Colombias high plains of the Páramo to its tropical forests, hummingbirds have evolved into an extraordinary number of species. Whether battling freezing rain or jungle predators, each mother must struggle to build a nest, protect her eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哥倫比亞洛斯亞諾斯的扁平稀樹草原受到季節性極端的影響,將生命推向絕境.在這個無情的舞台上,沒有第二次機會,只有最適應殘酷極端的生物才能度過一年.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The flat savannas of the Colombian Llanos are governed by seasonal extremes that push life to the brink. In this unforgiving arena, there are no second chances, and only creatures best adapted to their brutal extremes will make it through a year.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雌性絨頂檉柳猴蒙娜在她的熱帶森林家園獨居.她離開了原生家庭的安全區,尋找一個可能為她提供未來伴侶的未知隊伍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mona, a female cotton top tamarin is all alone in her tropical forest home. She has left the security of her birth family to search for an unrelated troop which might provide her with a future mate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與丹一同踏上旅程,穿越嚴酷無情的蒙古荒野,只為尋找那隻史上有紀錄以來體型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude).目睹他如何在充滿敵意,危機四伏的地形與環境中奮力前行,並在未知與不確定中披荊斬棘,同時揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面臨的艱難挑戰與嚴峻現實.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for The Dude, the largest snow leopard ever recorded. Watch him battle hostile landscapes and uncertainty as he sheds light on the challenges that The Dude and other snow leopards face.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探,追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵,更具影響力.當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sniff around The Dudes territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麗茲·戴利及其團隊前往潘塔納爾,追尋一隻失蹤的雄性美洲豹領袖,並親眼目睹年輕挑戰者之間的戰鬥.見證局外人巴達洛如何篡奪權力,並贏得菲拉和其他雌性美洲豹的歡心.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head out into the Pantanal with Lizzie and the Onçafari team on the hunt for a missing dominant male jaguar. Monitor the battle between young hopefuls, like outsider Badalo, who want to usurp his power and win over Fera and the other local females.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起拜會潘塔納爾美洲豹族群的女王菲拉,從旁觀察她教導淘氣的幼寶寶辛巴如何爬樹和捕獵.然後看看另一隻雌豹菲琳娜如何面對更多當地雄豹入侵領土,並威脅幼寶寶的存活.面對考驗,她必須為母職掙扎堅持.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know Fera, the Queen of the Pantanal, as she teaches her rambunctious cub Simba how to climb trees and hunt for dinner. Then learn why Ferinha, another local female, struggles with motherhood as more males move in and threaten the youngsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨科學家團隊在雨季過後重新走入美洲豹領地,進行一次具規模的搜索,以尋找菲琳娜,菲拉和巴達洛,因為他們的追蹤項圈已經丟失.迎接一位生物學家加入團隊,在他的協助下,麗茲·戴利為美洲豹重新安裝追蹤項圈,並添置高科技設備以記錄更多數據.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rejoin the team for some post-rainy-season drama as they search for Ferinha, Fera, and Badalo, whose tracking collars are missing. Meet a new biologist who helps Lizzie recollar the jaguars, adding a high-tech device that will record even more data.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 經歷風暴,洪水和停電,莉茲和獸醫霍亞雷斯仍奮力為更多美洲豹戴上項圈,情勢相當緊張.一起尋找巴達洛的下落,並嘗試在追蹤標籤掉落之前找到他,以及拜訪一隻團隊渴望研究的新䧳豹.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat as Lizzie and veterinarian Joares scramble to collar more jaguars amid storms, floods, and power outages. Try to pin down the elusive Badalo before his data-gathering tag drops off and meet a new female the team is eager to study.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證奧瑪法瑞團隊為新認識的䧳豹阿羅艾拉戴上項圈,並一瞥她的豹寶寶阿波羅.繼續追查巴達洛的落下,他似乎已深入森林;他的失蹤可能讓莉茲的突破性研究毀於一旦!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the Onçafari team get to know Aroeira, their newly collared female, and take a peek at Auroras cub, Apolo. Continue to track Badalo, who has moved deeper into the flooded forest, where he puts Lizzies game-changing research in jeopardy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 埃塞俄比亞的達納基勒窪地不僅是地球上最不適合居住的地方之一,而且是地質活動最活躍的地區之一.火山學家湯菲佛正帶著一群冒險的遊客穿過達納基勒去看爾塔阿雷火山.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Danakil Depression in Ethiopia is not only one of the most inhospitable places on Earth, but is one of the most geologically active. Now, volcanologist Tom Pfeiffer is taking a group of adventure tourists to cross the Danakil to see the Erte A...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速.觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊,與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺,與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物,並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從撒哈拉到荒野,於極端環境中學習動物如何適應急速變化的氣候並掙扎求存.與黑猩猩一起在洞穴中避難,看看駱駝以特別技巧飲用鹽水,並傾聽斑胸草雀為蛋寶寶由唱的歌,了解歌聲如何讓幼雛變得細小.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world. Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smaller.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的來臨,豹媽媽費芙和獅媽媽莎芭正在教導她們的幼寶寶如何在危機四伏的野外求存,並讓他們遠離成年雄性的威脅.看看獅王莫雷洛如何戰鬥,獵豹森娜蒂亞則試圖在戰場上證明自己的地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊貼莫雷洛獅群的行蹤;當冬季洪水到來時,他們因照顧幼獅而精疲力盡.見證獵豹幼寶寶如何作出艱難的決定,並目擊豹媽媽塞菲麗在經歷一場可怕的遭遇後,如何在自己家族與幼寶寶之間作出抉擇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track Molelos pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲是一個充滿獨特和非凡生物的大陸,牠們經歷數百萬年的進化所塑造.非洲也是人類的發源地,在自我進化之旅中,我們也跟非洲大陸的動物同行,但智慧帶領我們走了一條完全不同的道路.我們的好奇心使我們對周圍的世界充滿疑問,這些問題通過故事,神話和傳說得到了解答.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continents animals on our own journey of evolutio...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一個名叫茱麗葉塔的雌性黃金箭毒蛙在尋找羅密歐的故事.她即將下蛋,必須找一名雄性給它們授精.羅密歐的召喚引導她穿過森林,但穿越茂密的熱帶雨林並非易事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is the story of Julieta, a female golden dart frog, in search of her Romeo. Shes about to lay her eggs and must find a male to fertilize them. Romeos calls guide her through the forest, but crossing the dense rainforest is no easy feat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速.觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊,與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺,與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物,並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從撒哈拉到荒野,於極端環境中學習動物如何適應急速變化的氣候並掙扎求存.與黑猩猩一起在洞穴中避難,看看駱駝以特別技巧飲用鹽水,並傾聽斑胸草雀為蛋寶寶由唱的歌,了解歌聲如何讓幼雛變得細小.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world. Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smaller.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的來臨,豹媽媽費芙和獅媽媽莎芭正在教導她們的幼寶寶如何在危機四伏的野外求存,並讓他們遠離成年雄性的威脅.看看獅王莫雷洛如何戰鬥,獵豹森娜蒂亞則試圖在戰場上證明自己的地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊貼莫雷洛獅群的行蹤;當冬季洪水到來時,他們因照顧幼獅而精疲力盡.見證獵豹幼寶寶如何作出艱難的決定,並目擊豹媽媽塞菲麗在經歷一場可怕的遭遇後,如何在自己家族與幼寶寶之間作出抉擇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track Molelos pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲是一個充滿獨特和非凡生物的大陸,牠們經歷數百萬年的進化所塑造.非洲也是人類的發源地,在自我進化之旅中,我們也跟非洲大陸的動物同行,但智慧帶領我們走了一條完全不同的道路.我們的好奇心使我們對周圍的世界充滿疑問,這些問題通過故事,神話和傳說得到了解答.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continents animals on our own journey of evolutio...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一個名叫茱麗葉塔的雌性黃金箭毒蛙在尋找羅密歐的故事.她即將下蛋,必須找一名雄性給它們授精.羅密歐的召喚引導她穿過森林,但穿越茂密的熱帶雨林並非易事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is the story of Julieta, a female golden dart frog, in search of her Romeo. Shes about to lay her eggs and must find a male to fertilize them. Romeos calls guide her through the forest, but crossing the dense rainforest is no easy feat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麗茲·戴利及其團隊前往潘塔納爾,追尋一隻失蹤的雄性美洲豹領袖,並親眼目睹年輕挑戰者之間的戰鬥.見證局外人巴達洛如何篡奪權力,並贏得菲拉和其他雌性美洲豹的歡心.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head out into the Pantanal with Lizzie and the Onçafari team on the hunt for a missing dominant male jaguar. Monitor the battle between young hopefuls, like outsider Badalo, who want to usurp his power and win over Fera and the other local females.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探訪喀拉喀托之子火山(Anak Krakatoa),當它進入劇烈活躍階段時.這座火山被稱為「火之子」,它是喀拉喀托火山的後代,而喀拉喀托火山以現代史上最大規模的噴發而聞名.它的後代是否會重演同樣的模式?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit Anak Krakatoa as it enters a violent phase. Known as The Child of Fire, this volcano is an ancestor of Krakatoa, a volcano known for the largest eruption in modern history. Will its descendant repeat the pattern?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​追溯獅子從史前掠食者到現代統治者的崛起,隨著科學揭示塑造這位標誌性非洲獵手的戰鬥,聯繫和殘酷生存策略.沉浸在獅子社會的戲劇和高風險狩獵的情節中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trace the lions rise from prehistoric predator to modern ruler as science reveals the battles, bonds, and brutal survival strategies that have shaped this iconic African hunter. Get swept up in the drama of lion society and high-risk hunts.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抬頭觀看澳洲的天空,它經常為世界帶來最極端的天氣現象.與眾生一起等待清涼的季風雨降臨,看看閃電如何引燃大規模的野火,並驚嘆不同物種為適應這些極端環境,所展現的奇妙生存智慧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the worlds most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 仰望北美洲的天際,體驗強大而絢麗的自然現象.見證北極熊在極光下尋找食物,追蹤極地渦旋的冰冷路徑,並跟隨草原犬鼠家族躲避猛烈的龍捲風.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America. Watch polar bears search for food under the aurora borealis, map the frigid path of a polar vortex, and elude violent tornadoes with a prairie dog family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 智利獁是一頭只有半個象鼻的大象,全因偷獵者的陷阱.它本來用作捕捉羚羊的野味,但無差別地讓其它動物受傷,造成毀滅性的後果.智利獁現在必須在沒有大象最重要的附屬物情況下適應生活.她必須學會如何吃喝和洗澡以確保她能生存下去.嚴酷的旱季代表著更大的挑戰,她正奮力求存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk; losing the tip to a poachers snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. But the snares indiscriminate nature means other animals often fall foul of them, with devastating results. Chilema is ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在喀拉哈里南部的草原上,有一棵壯麗的駱駝刺樹.這棵相思樹已經在此屹立了兩個世紀.在這片乾旱的地貌中,這棵駱駝刺樹是大大小小生物的避難所.善於交際的織布鳥,綠豆象甲蟲和各種哺乳類動物在喀拉哈里活用這棵標誌性的樹.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries. This tree is never lonely, learn how it provides food, shelter and a hunting ground to many creatures.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起拜會潘塔納爾美洲豹族群的女王菲拉,從旁觀察她教導淘氣的幼寶寶辛巴如何爬樹和捕獵.然後看看另一隻雌豹菲琳娜如何面對更多當地雄豹入侵領土,並威脅幼寶寶的存活.面對考驗,她必須為母職掙扎堅持.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know Fera, the Queen of the Pantanal, as she teaches her rambunctious cub Simba how to climb trees and hunt for dinner. Then learn why Ferinha, another local female, struggles with motherhood as more males move in and threaten the youngsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的來臨,豹媽媽費芙和獅媽媽莎芭正在教導她們的幼寶寶如何在危機四伏的野外求存,並讓他們遠離成年雄性的威脅.看看獅王莫雷洛如何戰鬥,獵豹森娜蒂亞則試圖在戰場上證明自己的地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊貼莫雷洛獅群的行蹤;當冬季洪水到來時,他們因照顧幼獅而精疲力盡.見證獵豹幼寶寶如何作出艱難的決定,並目擊豹媽媽塞菲麗在經歷一場可怕的遭遇後,如何在自己家族與幼寶寶之間作出抉擇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track Molelos pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起拜會潘塔納爾美洲豹族群的女王菲拉,從旁觀察她教導淘氣的幼寶寶辛巴如何爬樹和捕獵.然後看看另一隻雌豹菲琳娜如何面對更多當地雄豹入侵領土,並威脅幼寶寶的存活.面對考驗,她必須為母職掙扎堅持.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know Fera, the Queen of the Pantanal, as she teaches her rambunctious cub Simba how to climb trees and hunt for dinner. Then learn why Ferinha, another local female, struggles with motherhood as more males move in and threaten the youngsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抬頭觀看澳洲的天空,它經常為世界帶來最極端的天氣現象.與眾生一起等待清涼的季風雨降臨,看看閃電如何引燃大規模的野火,並驚嘆不同物種為適應這些極端環境,所展現的奇妙生存智慧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the worlds most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 仰望北美洲的天際,體驗強大而絢麗的自然現象.見證北極熊在極光下尋找食物,追蹤極地渦旋的冰冷路徑,並跟隨草原犬鼠家族躲避猛烈的龍捲風.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America. Watch polar bears search for food under the aurora borealis, map the frigid path of a polar vortex, and elude violent tornadoes with a prairie dog family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 意大利的埃特納火山是對火山觀測者來說最好的地方之一,火山學家湯菲佛希望幸運地看到陣發性爆發,那是一次短暫而強烈的噴發,會產生壯觀的熔岩噴泉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Italys Mount Etna is one of the best places for volcano watchers and volcanologist Tom Pfeffier is hoping to get lucky and see a paroxysmal eruption, a short and very intense eruption that produces spectacular lava fountains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抬頭觀看澳洲的天空,它經常為世界帶來最極端的天氣現象.與眾生一起等待清涼的季風雨降臨,看看閃電如何引燃大規模的野火,並驚嘆不同物種為適應這些極端環境,所展現的奇妙生存智慧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the worlds most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes.
