epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America. Watch polar bears search for food under the aurora borealis, map the frigid path of a polar vortex, and elude violent tornadoes with a prairie dog family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在盧安瓜谷,強大的孟巴肯高獅群仍有17頭壯獅,但老化的雄性領導無以為繼.在北方,荷里活獅群中的六隻雌獅已經自給自足了三年,但沒有雄性與她們交配,可能導致族群滅絕.四名年輕流浪雄獅突然的造訪,似乎回應著荷里活獅群的祈禱.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the all-female Hollywood pride encounters the Nomads, a new pride of rival males, they may have found the answer to their mating dry spell. But they quickly realize that it will not be a happy encounter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 環遊世界去察看另一個季節性轉變.北半球踏入秋天,在澳洲見證一次重生,湯加溫暖的熱帶海域充滿交配的座頭鯨.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel around the world to see another seasonal change unfold. The Northern Hemisphere moves into autumn, while Australia witnesses a rebirth of life, and mating humpbacks fill the warming tropical seas of Tonga.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 於11月見證大自然一些最不可思議的事,從聚在墨西哥森林中的數百萬隻君主斑蝶,到籠罩著杜拜市的濃霧,標誌著冬天的開始.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness some of the most incredible natural events in November, from the millions of Monarch butterflies that converge in Mexicos forests to the deep fog that shrouds the city of Dubai, signalling the start of winter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 樹木是非洲最古老的居民,每棵樹木都有自己在旱季生存的戰略.臘腸樹和無花果樹在季節性極端情況下,向掙扎求存的動物提供食物和住所,共度時艱.作為回報,動物通過幫花卉授粉和分散種子來幫助這些樹木繁殖.非洲樹木促進生命,並成為地球上最珍貴生態系統之一的支柱.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trees are Africas oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是備受喜愛的香腸樹的浪漫故事.博茨瓦納東北角的塞林達保護區面臨艱難的一年.它十分乾旱,雨季還有幾個月才來到.在如此具有挑戰性的期間,許多鳥類和動物依靠香腸樹來維持生計.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the story of the much loved Sausage Tree, whose nectar filled blooms and sausage shaped fruits entice animals of all kinds, from insects to elephants. See how the very animals who rely on this generous tree ensure its proliferation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抬頭觀看澳洲的天空,它經常為世界帶來最極端的天氣現象.與眾生一起等待清涼的季風雨降臨,看看閃電如何引燃大規模的野火,並驚嘆不同物種為適應這些極端環境,所展現的奇妙生存智慧.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America. Watch polar bears search for food under the aurora borealis, map the frigid path of a polar vortex, and elude violent tornadoes with a prairie dog family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨科學家團隊在雨季過後重新走入美洲豹領地,進行一次具規模的搜索,以尋找菲琳娜,菲拉和巴達洛,因為他們的追蹤項圈已經丟失.迎接一位生物學家加入團隊,在他的協助下,麗茲·戴利為美洲豹重新安裝追蹤項圈,並添置高科技設備以記錄更多數據.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rejoin the team for some post-rainy-season drama as they search for Ferinha, Fera, and Badalo, whose tracking collars are missing. Meet a new biologist who helps Lizzie recollar the jaguars, adding a high-tech device that will record even more data.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏威夷島上人氣最高的旅遊景點是一座名為基拉韋亞的火山.在火山口板層突然倒塌後,一場大規模的火山爆發使熔岩枯竭,所以現在的基拉韋亞火山變得穩定,讓地質學家菲臘翁終於有機會探索它.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The number one tourist attraction on the island of Hawaii is a volcano called Kilauea. After a sudden collapse of the crater floor, a massive eruption drains the volcano of lava and now Kilauea is silent. Geologist Phillip Ong finally has his chan...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 環遊世界去察看另一個季節性轉變.北半球踏入秋天,在澳洲見證一次重生,湯加溫暖的熱帶海域充滿交配的座頭鯨.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness some of the most incredible natural events in November, from the millions of Monarch butterflies that converge in Mexicos forests to the deep fog that shrouds the city of Dubai, signalling the start of winter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在盧安瓜谷,荷里活獅群大難臨頭.流浪雄獅的侵襲使女族長阿華受了重傷.由於首領喪失能力,狩獵變得困難.在尋找獅子的過程中,阿森發現了一隻鬣狗幼崽,牠的母親去打獵時遺下牠.鬣狗與孟巴肯高獅群因爭奪一隻水牛的屍體而大打出手.彌敦收到驚喜:孟巴肯高獅群原來藏著更多的幼獅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hollywood pride reels after the Nomads brutal attack on their leader, Ava, leaves her desperately weak and unable to hunt. To add to her woes, her hungry pride start rejecting her. But without her, they struggle to bring down prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 團隊準備釋放兩隻被稱為藪貓的美麗且難以捕捉的斑點貓,但計劃出了亂子,其中一隻逃到危險的里朗威.同時,猴子嬰兒情況危急,全員出動救亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch as the Lilongwe Wildlife team try to release two serval cats into the wild. One escapes and returns injured. Will their release be successful? A new baby vervet arrives in critical condition, and a giant owl flies to freedom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿曼達進行了恐怖的開墾冒險之旅,以營救被偷獵者捕網抓獲的水羚.中心內的鬣狗居民的耳朵被蠅咬而接受治療.阿爾瑪接到了一個深夜運送猴子的神秘任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Amanda on a white knuckle bush-whacking adventure to rescue a waterbuck caught by a poachers snare. Meanwhile, the centers resident hyena is treated for flea bitten ears and Alma gets a mysterious late night monkey delivery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來到澳洲南部水域,展開一場具挑戰性的追蹤任務,並揭示鯊魚的食物來源和他們聚集於覓食熱點的原因.團隊之後一路向北,追蹤虎鯊,公牛鯊和錘頭鯊,並為他們其中一員裝上360度的背鰭攝像鏡頭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 索特潘斯山脈的高山地雨林中生長出巨大的奧特尼夸香槐樹.這是一個講述了這棵巨大的樹如何在她的枝梢中提供居所,飼養和庇護一眾動植物的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a misty South African forest grows a six hundred year old Outeniqua Yellowwood. At forty meters tall, she towers above the canopy and is one of the few remaining of her kind. Follow her captivating story, unique as the ecosystem in her branches.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 環遊世界去察看另一個季節性轉變.北半球踏入秋天,在澳洲見證一次重生,湯加溫暖的熱帶海域充滿交配的座頭鯨.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel around the world to see another seasonal change unfold. The Northern Hemisphere moves into autumn, while Australia witnesses a rebirth of life, and mating humpbacks fill the warming tropical seas of Tonga.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每位巨人都由嬰孩開始.大象,犀牛,大猩猩和野牛都有動物王國中最可愛的嬰兒,牠們是小巨人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elephants, gorillas, rhinos, and bison are among the largest and most imposing land-dwelling mammals, but they all start out as helpless infants. See how babies from each species find their way to becoming giants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 團隊準備釋放兩隻被稱為藪貓的美麗且難以捕捉的斑點貓,但計劃出了亂子,其中一隻逃到危險的里朗威.同時,猴子嬰兒情況危急,全員出動救亡.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Amanda on a white knuckle bush-whacking adventure to rescue a waterbuck caught by a poachers snare. Meanwhile, the centers resident hyena is treated for flea bitten ears and Alma gets a mysterious late night monkey delivery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四頭流浪雄獅組成的暴力團,正尋找可接管的獅群.他們在盧安瓜河的西岸徘徊,並已跟北方的荷里活雌獅群大打一場,現正南下進入強大的孟巴肯高獅群的地盤.孟巴肯高的雌獅群的狩獵隊阻止他們接近,但她們的策略只能持續幾天.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The lions of the Nomad pride rampage deep into the heart of the MK prides territory, scattering its members and coming dangerously close to the five new MK cubs. Meanwhile, the Hollywoods are recovering, and Avas survival skills are still intact.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速.觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊,與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺,與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物,並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著大堡礁追蹤一條懷孕的鯊魚,看看她能否帶領科學家團隊找到隱秘的生產地.然後到南部海岸尋找求偶中的鯊魚,並見證一條非常害羞的雌性巨鯊如何發現愛情.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 納馬夸岩無花果樹紮根於南非納馬夸蘭的岩石山坡上.它是最終的倖存者,能夠承受每年不斷上升的溫度和越來越少的降雨量這等無情的環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證奧瑪法瑞團隊為新認識的䧳豹阿羅艾拉戴上項圈,並一瞥她的豹寶寶阿波羅.繼續追查巴達洛的落下,他似乎已深入森林;他的失蹤可能讓莉茲的突破性研究毀於一旦!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the Onçafari team get to know Aroeira, their newly collared female, and take a peek at Auroras cub, Apolo. Continue to track Badalo, who has moved deeper into the flooded forest, where he puts Lizzies game-changing research in jeopardy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速.觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊,與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺,與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物,並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著大堡礁追蹤一條懷孕的鯊魚,看看她能否帶領科學家團隊找到隱秘的生產地.然後到南部海岸尋找求偶中的鯊魚,並見證一條非常害羞的雌性巨鯊如何發現愛情.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 納馬夸岩無花果樹紮根於南非納馬夸蘭的岩石山坡上.它是最終的倖存者,能夠承受每年不斷上升的溫度和越來越少的降雨量這等無情的環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 團隊準備釋放兩隻被稱為藪貓的美麗且難以捕捉的斑點貓,但計劃出了亂子,其中一隻逃到危險的里朗威.同時,猴子嬰兒情況危急,全員出動救亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch as the Lilongwe Wildlife team try to release two serval cats into the wild. One escapes and returns injured. Will their release be successful? A new baby vervet arrives in critical condition, and a giant owl flies to freedom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿曼達進行了恐怖的開墾冒險之旅,以營救被偷獵者捕網抓獲的水羚.中心內的鬣狗居民的耳朵被蠅咬而接受治療.阿爾瑪接到了一個深夜運送猴子的神秘任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Amanda on a white knuckle bush-whacking adventure to rescue a waterbuck caught by a poachers snare. Meanwhile, the centers resident hyena is treated for flea bitten ears and Alma gets a mysterious late night monkey delivery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證奧瑪法瑞團隊為新認識的䧳豹阿羅艾拉戴上項圈,並一瞥她的豹寶寶阿波羅.繼續追查巴達洛的落下,他似乎已深入森林;他的失蹤可能讓莉茲的突破性研究毀於一旦!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the Onçafari team get to know Aroeira, their newly collared female, and take a peek at Auroras cub, Apolo. Continue to track Badalo, who has moved deeper into the flooded forest, where he puts Lizzies game-changing research in jeopardy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在動物王國中,大部分動物於出生時都無力自保.在溺愛牠們的母親監護下,牠們很快成為同類的主宰.本集的重點是動物王國中一些偉大的母親.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Not all infants in the animal kingdom get to have a good mother. But these are the stories of the lucky ones, from a ring-tailed lemur who learns everything from its mom to a tiny orangutan that receives a constant supply of motherly cuddles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集動物朋友仔中,一隻鴨子若沒有她的狗仔朋友搭載,就決不下水,一頭以為自己是野牛的大象,還有一群收養了一隻小鹿孤兒的母牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a duck that wont go in the water without a ride from her pooch pal, an elephant that thinks shes a buffalo, and a herd of cows that adopt an orphaned deer.

epg.programme_title_en: Secret Life of the Tasmanian Devil 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 澳洲的環保主義者定期監測眾多他們照顧的袋獾的生活.兩歲的卡路士就是其中之一.牠清醒的大部分時間都在嘗試尋找食物.雖然袋獾確實在白天活動,但黃昏才是最活躍的時段.袋獾是獨居的,但當牠們相遇,就會打鬥起來.對於像卡路士這樣的雄性來說,這關乎支配地位.繁殖季節開始時,雌性將青睞佔優的雄性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For Tasmanian devils, dominance is the name of the game during mating season. Meet males who fight for the right to pass on their genes, and learn about the violent, noisy etiquette of these carnivorous marsupials mealtime.

epg.programme_title_en: Secret Life of the Tasmanian Devil 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 袋獾可能擁有全國任何一個有袋類動物最惡名昭著的聲譽,但這些精力充沛的小拳手也有另一面,牠們是好父母和小孩保護者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tasmanian Devils might have the most infamous reputations of any of the countrys marsupials, but these spirited scrappers also have another side. Theyre committed parents and heroic defenders of their pouch-reared young.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 熱帶太平洋生活中的一天.在小島上,科莫多巨蜥爭奪食物殘渣,而招潮蟹則在海灘上決鬥.在海底,蝠鱝於深海滑翔,奇特的行走鯊魚在色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁中巡邏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Live through a sunny tropical September day with creatures from Polynesia to the Indonesian archipelago. See how the sun affects the movement, feeding habits, and mating rituals of everything from tiny zooplankton to whale sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是澳洲春季的第一天,從風流的樹熊到拳擊袋鼠,再到選擇今天開餐令人驚訝地快速的眼斑巨蜥,獨特的動物們就開始春日狂熱.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celebrate the first day of spring with Aussie creatures looking for either a dinner or a date. From the kangaroos in the grasslands to the koalas in the trees to the freshwater crocodiles, they hunt for food or fight for breeding rights.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬達加斯加展開雨季的一天.環尾狐猴和七彩的變色龍帶領一群獨特的動物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the unique primates and reptiles searching for water and dodging predators, from ring-tailed lemurs in the east coast rainforests to tiny brown leaf chameleons, in this land of extreme climate variations and habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太陽在這個乾旱的半島上統管一切,尤其是在七月.但從單峰駱駝到如幻術師般的科威特蜥蜴,再到可愛的蹄兔,牠們都有特殊的適應能力來抵抗沙漠的高溫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit one of the most arid and hottest parts of the world to discover how dhub lizards and dromedary camels adapted to withstand the intense conditions. Then move into the more moderate southern mountains, where rare hyrax and chameleons forage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲是一個充滿獨特和非凡生物的大陸,牠們經歷數百萬年的進化所塑造.非洲也是人類的發源地,在自我進化之旅中,我們也跟非洲大陸的動物同行,但智慧帶領我們走了一條完全不同的道路.我們的好奇心使我們對周圍的世界充滿疑問,這些問題通過故事,神話和傳說得到了解答.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continents animals on our own journey of evolutio...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 智利獁是一頭只有半個象鼻的大象,全因偷獵者的陷阱.它本來用作捕捉羚羊的野味,但無差別地讓其它動物受傷,造成毀滅性的後果.智利獁現在必須在沒有大象最重要的附屬物情況下適應生活.她必須學會如何吃喝和洗澡以確保她能生存下去.嚴酷的旱季代表著更大的挑戰,她正奮力求存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk; losing the tip to a poachers snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. But the snares indiscriminate nature means other animals often fall foul of them, with devastating results. Chilema is ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 樹木是非洲最古老的居民,每棵樹木都有自己在旱季生存的戰略.臘腸樹和無花果樹在季節性極端情況下,向掙扎求存的動物提供食物和住所,共度時艱.作為回報,動物通過幫花卉授粉和分散種子來幫助這些樹木繁殖.非洲樹木促進生命,並成為地球上最珍貴生態系統之一的支柱.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trees are Africas oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來到澳洲南部水域,展開一場具挑戰性的追蹤任務,並揭示鯊魚的食物來源和他們聚集於覓食熱點的原因.團隊之後一路向北,追蹤虎鯊,公牛鯊和錘頭鯊,並為他們其中一員裝上360度的背鰭攝像鏡頭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著大堡礁追蹤一條懷孕的鯊魚,看看她能否帶領科學家團隊找到隱秘的生產地.然後到南部海岸尋找求偶中的鯊魚,並見證一條非常害羞的雌性巨鯊如何發現愛情.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起走訪迅速融化的極地,看看動物向科學家們留下有關我們未來存留的啟示與線索.了解北極熊,企鵝和其他極地生物的動靜如何幫助人類制定應對全球暖化之計.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek to the planets quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map (and prevent) global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上非常重要,卻受到忽視的棲息地之一,了解草原在減緩氣候變化上的角色,其吸收碳的容量比森林更大.接着拜會野牛和美洲獅等關鍵物種,看看他們如何幫助恢復生態資源,並治癒我們的星球.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore one of Earths most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​追溯獅子從史前掠食者到現代統治者的崛起,隨著科學揭示塑造這位標誌性非洲獵手的戰鬥,聯繫和殘酷生存策略.沉浸在獅子社會的戲劇和高風險狩獵的情節中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trace the lions rise from prehistoric predator to modern ruler as science reveals the battles, bonds, and brutal survival strategies that have shaped this iconic African hunter. Get swept up in the drama of lion society and high-risk hunts.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面對海洋中最具多樣性和威脅性的掠食者.了解幫助這種史前物種在多次大規模滅絕中生存下來的生物優勢,然後驚嘆於公牛鯊無情的狩獵技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Confront the oceans most versatile and formidable predator. Learn about the biological advantages that helped this prehistoric species survive multiple mass extinctions, then get awed by the relentless hunting skills of bull sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與鯊魚一起在海中潛行,看他們使用高度敏銳的感官和殺手的本能進行捕獵.觀看白頂礁鯊利用其電子傳感器探測心跳來尋找獵物,以及淺海長尾鯊用其鞭狀的尾巴來擊暈獵物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stalk the seas with sharks as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. Watch a whitetip reef shark put its electrical sensors to work finding its preys heartbeat, and the pelagic thresher shark stun its quarry with its whiplike tail.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與那些在藍色的虛空中繁衍生息的流浪鯊魚一起領略海洋的廣闊,深邃與黑暗.見識穿越大西洋風暴的海域的孤獨藍鯊,以及返回太平洋島嶼繁殖地的數百條雙髻鯊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate the oceans vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness. Meet a lone blue shark traversing stormy Atlantic seas, and hundreds of hammerheads returning to their Pacific island breeding ground.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨一群具有非凡能力的鯊魚,牠們可以在全球最惡劣的環境中繁衍生息.觀察在冰冷的北極水域生活,但幾乎失明的格林蘭鯊,以及另外一種能在陸地行走的物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起走訪迅速融化的極地,看看動物向科學家們留下有關我們未來存留的啟示與線索.了解北極熊,企鵝和其他極地生物的動靜如何幫助人類制定應對全球暖化之計.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: New popular pets of the dark world have all "crawled" out and gathered together?! Dark cuisines made from insects can also taste delicious?! Eye-opening! Cold and arrogant reptiles can be obedient?! Experts demonstrate how to take care of reptiles at home in person?! Surprise! All cute dark pets are present at a gathering of reptile friends?!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: New popular pets of the dark world have all "crawled" out and gathered together?! Dark cuisines made from insects can also taste delicious?! Eye-opening! Cold and arrogant reptiles can be obedient?! Experts demonstrate how to take care of reptiles at home in person?! Surprise! All cute dark pets are present at a gathering of reptile friends?!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dr. Matt gets to play nanny to a very tiny but very vocal abandoned baby badger, and meets Vicky, the lovesick cockatoo who's fallen in love with her owner, in the seventh of the series.  Up at the zoo Matt fills in the cracks in a tortoise's shell and then meets the latest additions to the aquarium 20 baby seahorses, much to the delight of keeper Jackie.  High on the North York Moors an unruly alpaca faces castration, while back at the surgery Matt renews an old acquaintance - Archie the iguana is back, this time to have part of his tail removed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!
They are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Because of her love for cats, Claire carefully created a place called "There is a Cat at the Corner". While enjoying your meals and drinks, more than a dozen beautiful cats are strolling freely in the store, waiting to interact with you up close and enjoy a slow life with you. Claire also generously shares her “experiences in ruling over dozens of cats”, which is extremely precious. Novice cat lovers should come and have a look!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A lone cow has gone wild and escaped into a neighbouring field.Dr. Matt has been called in to lend a hand. Cathy discovers two Jack Russell types and two Yorkshire Terriers. Tragically, they were too late one for one dog that had passed away and another has badly fractured leg. Will Cathy be able to provide the escape that these dogs desperately need?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Inspector Herchy Boal teams up with the police to attend a property near Birmingham suspected of puppy farming. Tragically, for one puppy it was already too late, but she manages to rescue another 37 including 8 expectant mothers. Herchy discovers a range of breeds including Shih-Tzu’s, West Highland Terriers and Cavashons, but with many pups still yet to be born, how will they all get on?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

Moreover, in this small ecosystem, most players are male and they even jokingly describe each other as "going underwater"; "Cute Pet Guide" takes you to appreciate the mystery of "going underwater"!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Inspector Herchy Boal teams up with the police to attend a property near Birmingham suspected of puppy farming. Tragically, for one puppy it was already too late, but she manages to rescue another 37 including 8 expectant mothers. Herchy discovers a range of breeds including Shih-Tzu’s, West Highland Terriers and Cavashons, but with many pups still yet to be born, how will they all get on?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".

But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The era of high housing prices shocks the masses. However, some are willing to live in the mountains for their beloved parrots, just to give them the best breeding environment. If you want to raise a parrot, there are in fact many restrictions on choosing the right one. How should I put it? Don’t miss “Cute Pet Guide”!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Early morning at the Brash household and Dr. Matt and his wife Clare, a horse vet, with their children enjoy a traditional English breakfast - on a traditional Dales day. They're off to the Malton Show. It's been an annual event for over a century, a chance for local people to meet and compete for prizes with their finest produce.  In a rural community, vets are crucial. Matt started as a farm vet before specialising in exotic animals. The show also gives him an opportunity to keep in touch with livestock.

Indian food isn't just all beaten copper pots and traditional curry. In this episode, we look at all the innovations in modern Indian cuisine. There are chefs in India pushing the envelope and Samira gets invited into the kitchens of some of India's top Avant Garde chefs, who create exotic twists to three quintessential Indian dishes.

Samira's tryst for all things beautiful, guides her towards modernist Indian food, where flavours of the subcontinent meet new age culinary techniques in cooking and plating.

There are enough tips for the home chef to try at home. Samira tries her own hand with new ideas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Indian food is becoming a staple in most big cities around the world. But its desserts have taken a back seat to some of its popular main courses. Samira finds out all about the spectacular buffet of desserts India has to offer, before making some in her own kitchen. Telling her viewers, the history of Indian sweets starting with its beginnings as devotional, spiritual temple food for the Gods, before learning how to make them. Flavored kulfi (Indian Ice Creams) Indian Funnel Cakes or Jalebi,Gulab Jamun and fusion desserts like a Phirni cheese cake, an Indian rice pudding.

She ends up back home in New York eating cupcakes from one of her favorite bakeries in Times Square.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye. She packs her bags and sets off. 

New York’s signature street food is the hot dog. In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years. Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
The whole world loves a good curry, and living in New York, Samira loves to make curries, Indian, South East Asian and the Western stew, but she heads back to India where she learns how to make some of India’s finest curries. 

Here is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry. The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets. 

This episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
The whole world loves a good curry, and living in New York, Samira loves to make curries, Indian, South East Asian and the Western stew, but she heads back to India where she learns how to make some of India’s finest curries. 

Here is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry. The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets. 

This episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
As the world is gradually turning more vegetarian, and its metropolitan cities are
adopting more juice and salad bars into their restaurant culture, Samira heads
back to India to explore its vast vegetarian cuisine and its origins…

In this episode, Samira traces the roots of vegetarianism in India, in temples as food for the gods, solves the mystery of the giant family paper Dosa, gives healthy tips and tricks on quick and easy vegetarian snacks and explores the amazing Teas of India and ends up cooking some delicious Indian fritters to go with her cup of cha!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
As the world is gradually turning more vegetarian, and its metropolitan cities are
adopting more juice and salad bars into their restaurant culture, Samira heads
back to India to explore its vast vegetarian cuisine and its origins…

In this episode, Samira traces the roots of vegetarianism in India, in temples as food for the gods, solves the mystery of the giant family paper Dosa, gives healthy tips and tricks on quick and easy vegetarian snacks and explores the amazing Teas of India and ends up cooking some delicious Indian fritters to go with her cup of cha!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Indian food isn't just all beaten copper pots and traditional curry. In this episode, we look at all the innovations in modern Indian cuisine. There are chefs in India pushing the envelope and Samira gets invited into the kitchens of some of India's top Avant Garde chefs, who create exotic twists to three quintessential Indian dishes.

Samira's tryst for all things beautiful, guides her towards modernist Indian food, where flavours of the subcontinent meet new age culinary techniques in cooking and plating.

There are enough tips for the home chef to try at home. Samira tries her own hand with new ideas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Indian food is becoming a staple in most big cities around the world. But its desserts have taken a back seat to some of its popular main courses. Samira finds out all about the spectacular buffet of desserts India has to offer, before making some in her own kitchen. Telling her viewers, the history of Indian sweets starting with its beginnings as devotional, spiritual temple food for the Gods, before learning how to make them. Flavored kulfi (Indian Ice Creams) Indian Funnel Cakes or Jalebi,Gulab Jamun and fusion desserts like a Phirni cheese cake, an Indian rice pudding.

She ends up back home in New York eating cupcakes from one of her favorite bakeries in Times Square.

Samira finds out all about the spectacular buffet of desserts India has to offer, before making some in her own kitchen. Telling her viewers, the history of Indian sweets starting with its beginnings as devotional, spiritual temple food for the Gods, before learning how to make them. Flavored kulfi (Indian Ice Creams) Indian Funnel Cakes or Jalebi,Gulab Jamun and fusion desserts like a Phirni cheese cake, an Indian rice pudding.

She ends up back home in New York eating cupcakes from one of her favorite bakeries in Times Square.

epg.programme_title_tc: It's More Fun in the Philippines
epg.programme_title_en: It's More Fun in the Philippines
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It's the final day exploring Palawan for Alex and Mel, and they visit a luxurious private island before returning to Manila for a spot of partying to say goodbye.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It's the final day exploring Palawan for Alex and Mel, and they visit a luxurious private island before returning to Manila for a spot of partying to say goodbye.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ellen Coughlan leaves the big city and out into New York State. It’s a big place with room for Sailing, rope adventure, famous hot dogs and Woodstock.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ellen Coughlan leaves the big city and out into New York State. It’s a big place with room for Sailing, rope adventure, famous hot dogs and Woodstock.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we explore why and how animals fight and reveal the ways in which they are programmed to survive at all costs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we meet some animal elders who help us understand the psychological mechanisms associated with long life and the positive social value long-lived animals bring to their communities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往冰島雷克雅未克,發現一種真心刺激的傳統和現代美食.他用大蒜牛油烹調經典的挪威龍蝦,還有醃三文魚和檸汁魚生,麥芽麵包和在間歇泉中焗製的蛋糕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Reykjavik, Iceland, to discover a truly exciting traditional and modern cuisine. She prepares a local classic of langoustines in garlic butter, and there is also gravadlax and ceviche, malted bread, and cakes cooked in a geyser.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利的街頭美食長徵於大阪落幕,他在當地發現了製作大阪燒的藝術,有點像用班㦸包裹的英國早餐,嘗試日本風的小食,並製作生蠔天婦羅和辣蝦烏冬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsleys street food odyssey concludes in Osaka, where he discovers the art of making okonomiyaki, a bit like an English breakfast wrapped in a pancake, tries tapas Japanese style, and makes oyster tempura and udon noodles with chili prawns.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往義大利西西里島的巴勒摩,並用上即捕的吞拿魚在海灘上準備海鮮麵食.他又品嚐了包括炸魷魚,釀沙甸魚和島上獨特香蒜醬的地道美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Palermo on the Italian island of Sicily and prepares seafood pasta on the beach, using freshly caught tuna; Ainsley samples local delicacies including fried calamari, stuffed sardines and the islands unique recipe for pesto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往臺灣,發現它是世上最偉大的美食聖地之一.他發現香燉魚和辣炒豬肉,並用大蒜和辣椒煮臺灣大蝦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Taiwan and discovers it is one of the greatest food destinations in the world. He finds fragrant braised fish and chilli pork stir-fry, and cooks Taiwan prawns with garlic and chilli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在日本的中心狼吞虎嚥著素壽司和拉麵.他從新學習煮蕎麥麵,自製麻糬,並參加傳統茶道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of Japan, Mena devours plant-based sushi and ramen. He learns to cook soba noodles from scratch, home-made mochi, and takes part in a traditional tea ceremony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在世界著名的克魯格國家公園及附近開展第二趟南非美食之行.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren commences his second Food Trail of South Africa in the world famous Kruger National Park and surrounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 約翰尼斯堡是探索南非的門戶城市!華倫在本集沉迷於深受當地人和遊客喜愛的桑頓區及周邊和精彩的國際口味.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johannesburg - the gateway city to exploring South Africa! In this episode Warren indulges in the vibrant international flavours and surrounds of the Sandton neighbourhood, loved by locals and visitors alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在你從未見過的南非狂野東北海岸,華倫會發現自己愛上那空蕩蕩的海灘,粗獷的開放汪洋和充滿野生河馬的水道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wild northeast coast of South Africa is like nothing you』ve seen. And it’s here Warren will find himself romanced by empty beaches, rugged open oceans, and waterways filled with wild hippopotamus.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在本集體驗當地豐富的野生物種,他主要在追蹤和尋找難以捉摸並瀕臨絕種的非洲野狗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, Warren experiences the abundance of wildlife here, centering his experience around tracking and finding the elusive and endangered African Wild Dog.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利發現馬德裡是個充滿秘密的城市.首先這個沉迷美食的城市禁止街頭美食.那麼當地人如何繞過這道禁令呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley discovers that Madrid is a city of secrets. The first one comes as a bit of a shock: street food is banned in this food-obsessed city. So how do the locals get round this?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利來到摩洛哥,但他沒有去馬拉喀什或卡薩布蘭加,而是去了豐富多彩,混亂而夢幻的費茲.雜亂無序的麥地那是世界遺產,也是通往另一個時代的門戶.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley lands in Morocco, but he doesnt go to Marrakesch or Casablanca, but to the colourful, chaotic and dreamy city of Fes. The sprawling medina is a World Heritage site and a gateway to another time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利到訪檳島首都喬治敦,馬來西亞人發現這個沉迷美食的國家中最好的街頭食品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley visits Georgetown, the capital of Penang island, where Malaysians come to discover the best street food in this food-obsessed country.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利在美食之旅的最後一站到訪問約旦的安曼,那是來自伊拉克,黎巴嫩,巴勒斯坦和敘利亞中東一族叫作家的交匯處.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the final leg of his culinary journey, Ainsley visits Amman in Jordan, the crossroads in the Middle East that families from Iraq, Lebanon, Palestine and Syria now call home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們.四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet some late-life lovers and explore the reasons behind their sexual longevity and their ability to reproduce well into their later years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著動物老去,如何保持領導地位?我們調查作為一個狼群年老領導者所承擔的責任與挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does it take to maintain alpha status as animals grow older? We investigate the responsibilities and challenges that come with being a senior leader of a pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們探索老年動物對構成其群體是如何不可或缺,並研究動物在其生命過程中如何學習.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We explore the integral role that older animals play in their communities and investigate how animals learn over the course of their lives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人類,植物,動物,細菌,都有一個避無可避的共通點:死亡.我們在本集發現老化的動物如何違背我們對生命周期的常理認知.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Human, plant, animal, bacteria, all have one inevitable thing in common; death. In this episode we discover the ways in which aging animals defy our usual understanding of the circle of life.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解P-47雷霆式戰鬥機如何在德國和太平洋地區制霸空戰,還能同時對地面造成破壞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the P-47 Thunderbolt dominated the skies while dealing destruction on the ground in both Germany and the Pacific.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從夜間追蹤任務到救援行動,了解MH-6小鳥直昇機如何在其他大型機體中贏得一席之地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From night stalker missions to rescue operations, see how the Little Bird helicopter earned its place among the big boys.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看大型軍用C-5銀河運輸機在超過半世紀的服役生涯中多次的高光時刻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the massive military transport aircraft C-5 Galaxy come up big time and again over its five decades of service

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從古羅馬的工程奇蹟到託斯卡尼中世紀的血腥戰事,還有卡拉拉巨大的大理石採石場,以前所未有的方式穿越義大利中部- 從空中探索它.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the engineering wonders of ancient Rome to the bloody medieval battles of Tuscany, and the colossal marble quarries of Carrara, journey across Central Italy and discover it like never before - from the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從時尚之都米蘭出發,渡過威尼斯大運河,到達脫俗的多羅米提山脈和色彩繽紛的五漁村海岸,以前所未有的方式從空中探索義大利北部.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey from the fashion capital to Milan, across the great canals of Venice to the otherworldly peaks of the Dolomites and the colorful coast of Cinque Terre to discover Northern Italy like never before - from the air.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中.溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥,覓食和躲避掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is now June, and the park is bathed in 17 hours of daylight. With the warm temperatures come rich pickings, but for the newborn the summer months are crucial as they learn to fight, find food and avoid predators.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 秋季是雄鹿爭相繁殖,魚鷹雛鳥開展3000英裡西非遷徙,三文魚返回牠們出生的河流,極北蝰產子的季節.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is when stags compete to breed, osprey chicks begin a 3000-mile migration to West Africa, salmon return to the rivers where they were born and adders give birth to live young.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天溫和潮濕,對不同動物來說,是好消息,也可以是壞消息.歐洲馬鹿被逼移到更高的地方,三文魚已經半年沒有食物,山兔變成了顯眼的白色,松鼠將自己的幼崽趕出巢穴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The winter is mild and wet, which is good news for some but bad news for others. Red deer are forced to higher ground, salmon have gone six months without food, mountain hares turn a conspicuous white, and squirrels kick their own young out of the ne

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we explore why and how animals fight and reveal the ways in which they are programmed to survive at all costs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we meet some animal elders who help us understand the psychological mechanisms associated with long life and the positive social value long-lived animals bring to their communities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet some late-life lovers and explore the reasons behind their sexual longevity and their ability to reproduce well into their later years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著動物老去,如何保持領導地位?我們調查作為一個狼群年老領導者所承擔的責任與挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does it take to maintain alpha status as animals grow older? We investigate the responsibilities and challenges that come with being a senior leader of a pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們探索老年動物對構成其群體是如何不可或缺,並研究動物在其生命過程中如何學習.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We explore the integral role that older animals play in their communities and investigate how animals learn over the course of their lives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人類,植物,動物,細菌,都有一個避無可避的共通點:死亡.我們在本集發現老化的動物如何違背我們對生命周期的常理認知.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Human, plant, animal, bacteria, all have one inevitable thing in common; death. In this episode we discover the ways in which aging animals defy our usual understanding of the circle of life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這塊巨大的磁石將徹底改變世界和產能的未來.法國南部正建造目前世上最大的核融合反應堆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This giant magnet will revolutionize the world and energy production in the future. The worlds largest nuclear fusion reactor is currently under construction in southern France.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著電子遊戲崛起,科技巨頭索尼嘗試與任天堂合作.但在一次驚人的背叛後,索尼創立了後來成為世上最成功的遊戲主機.Playstation從此屹立不倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With video-games on the rise, Sony, the tech superpower would attempt a collaboration with Nintendo. After a shocking betrayal, Sony founded what would become the world’s most successful chain of video game consoles. The Playstation was here to stay.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探索加密貨幣的基礎,並與當地冒著一切風險的加密貨幣先驅面談.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we explore the foundations of Cryptocurrency and talk to the local crypto pioneers who risked it all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在我們知道為何加密貨幣是何等大事,而我們在本集將認識紐西蘭最大的加密貨幣成功故事之一背後的家族.我們將破除一些加密神話並介紹如何參與的入門.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Now we know why Crypto is such a big deal, through this episode we』ll meet the family behind one of NZ’s biggest Crypto success stories. We』ll dispel some crypto myths and cover the basics of how to get on board.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由著名英國演員比爾奈伊聲音導航,這部優質的自然歷史系列揭示令人震驚和稀有的生物所面臨的挑戰,同時造就牠們家園獨特的環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Narrated by acclaimed English actor Bill Nighy, this blue-chip natural history series reveals the challenges faced by the astounding and rare creatures that make this unique environment their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由著名英國演員比爾奈伊聲音導航,這部優質的自然歷史系列揭示令人震驚和稀有的生物所面臨的挑戰,同時造就牠們家園獨特的環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Narrated by acclaimed English actor Bill Nighy, this blue-chip natural history series reveals the challenges faced by the astounding and rare creatures that make this unique environment their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在日本的中心狼吞虎嚥著素壽司和拉麵.他從新學習煮蕎麥麵,自製麻糬,並參加傳統茶道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of Japan, Mena devours plant-based sushi and ramen. He learns to cook soba noodles from scratch, home-made mochi, and takes part in a traditional tea ceremony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在世界著名的克魯格國家公園及附近開展第二趟南非美食之行.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren commences his second Food Trail of South Africa in the world famous Kruger National Park and surrounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 約翰尼斯堡是探索南非的門戶城市!華倫在本集沉迷於深受當地人和遊客喜愛的桑頓區及周邊和精彩的國際口味.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johannesburg - the gateway city to exploring South Africa! In this episode Warren indulges in the vibrant international flavours and surrounds of the Sandton neighbourhood, loved by locals and visitors alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在你從未見過的南非狂野東北海岸,華倫會發現自己愛上那空蕩蕩的海灘,粗獷的開放汪洋和充滿野生河馬的水道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wild northeast coast of South Africa is like nothing you』ve seen. And it’s here Warren will find himself romanced by empty beaches, rugged open oceans, and waterways filled with wild hippopotamus.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在本集體驗當地豐富的野生物種,他主要在追蹤和尋找難以捉摸並瀕臨絕種的非洲野狗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, Warren experiences the abundance of wildlife here, centering his experience around tracking and finding the elusive and endangered African Wild Dog.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探討瑪麗蓮如何反對裸體,以及她怎樣一躍成星.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyn’s defiance about posing nude and how it catapults her to stardom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮決心成為認真的演員,以及她離開二十世紀霍士創辦自己的製作公司.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyn’s determination to become a serious actress and her departure from Twentieth Century Fox to start her own production company.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮如何展現她成熟的演員天賦,還有紅顏薄命的她剛戰勝二十世紀霍士就香消玉殞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores how Marilyn shows her mature talent as an actress and wins a triumphant victory over Twentieth Century Fox shortly before her untimely death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們.四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. It’s time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德拜訪提姆.艾利斯--這位年輕執行長是相對論太空公司的創辦人,該公司打造並發射了全球第一枚3D列印火箭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Tim Ellis. A young CEO, Tim is the founder of Relativity Space, the company that built and launched the world’s first 3D printed rocket.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德獲得前所未有的機會,進入全球最神秘的藝術作品之一--詹姆斯.特瑞爾的〈羅登火山口〉.在這座火山口中,藝術以光與宇宙為題展開探索.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard are given unprecedented access to one of the world’s most guarded artworks: James Turrell’s Roden Crater. Inside the volcanic crater, the art explores the use of light and the cosmos.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見鞋履設計師歐瑪.貝利,他正改寫運動鞋文化.歐瑪的 FCTRY LAb 為音樂人與運動員創造創新鞋款,如今他將以 ARCH 為靈感設計全新靴子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Omar Bailey, a shoe designer revolutionizing sneaker culture. Omar’s FCTRY LAb has created innovative shoes for musicians and athletes. Now, he』ll create a boot inspired by ARCH.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 它們的形狀和大小各適其適,是可怕的火山,偉大的古代文明,還有地球上最清澈水域的家.它們就是迷人的義大利島國.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: They come in all shapes and sizes, are home to terrifying volcanoes, magnificent ancient civilizations, and some of the bluest waters on Earth. These are the fascinating worlds of Italys Islands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這裡擁有地中海一些最美麗的希臘神廟,似乎漂浮在海上的城市,還有地球上其中一個威力最大的火山,義大利這地區感覺就如平行世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With some of the most beautiful Greek temples on the Mediterranean, cities that just seem to float above the sea, and one of the most powerful volcanoes on Earth, this region of Italy feels like another world.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥斯大黎加 : 大自然的面紗 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯大黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥斯大黎加 : 大自然的面紗 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯大黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利在美食之旅的最後一站到訪問約旦的安曼,那是來自伊拉克,黎巴嫩,巴勒斯坦和敘利亞中東一族叫作家的交匯處.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the final leg of his culinary journey, Ainsley visits Amman in Jordan, the crossroads in the Middle East that families from Iraq, Lebanon, Palestine and Syria now call home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在日本發現了一連串樂趣.在寒冷的北海道北島上,他品嚐了海膽,池沼公魚和精緻的芝士蛋糕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw discovers a host of delights in Japan. On the wintry northern island of Hokkaido, he samples sea urchin, pond smelt and boutique cheesecake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明與漁民們一起出海,抓捕到所謂的百萬金槍.他還遇到一位在2011年海嘯中救了他員工的豉油製造商.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes to sea with the fishermen who caught the so-called `million-dollar tuna. He also meets a soy sauce maker who saved his staff from the 2011 tsunami.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明繼續他的日本烹飪之旅,準備新鮮的壽司,並前往妻子家鄉沉醉一些家鄉滋味.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his culinary tour of Japan, preparing fresh sushi and taking a trip to his wifes hometown to indulge in a little home cooking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明繼續他的日本烹飪朝聖之旅,品嚐一些最頂級的味噌,名古屋雞肉和和牛,並認識了一位年屆74歲的採鮑潛水員.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his culinary pilgrimage in Japan, devouring some of the finest miso, Nagoya chicken and Wagyu beef, and meeting a 74-year-old abalone diver.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮如何展現她成熟的演員天賦,還有紅顏薄命的她剛戰勝二十世紀霍士就香消玉殞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores how Marilyn shows her mature talent as an actress and wins a triumphant victory over Twentieth Century Fox shortly before her untimely death.

epg.programme_title_en: Keanu Reeves: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 踏上基努・李維的人生旅程,回顧他的成長歲月,多變的影視作品,以及情感起伏,揭開這位備受愛戴的偶像魅力所在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The journey of Keanu Reeves, travel through his youth, his versatile filmography and his many emotinal peaks and troughs to uncover what makes this fantastic icon so celebrated.

epg.programme_title_tc: 摩根費裡曼:不可思議的生涯
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入探索摩根・費裡曼的人生旅程--從奮鬥與逆境,到塑造好萊塢的傳奇地位與獨一無二的標誌性嗓音.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey through the life of Morgan Freeman-his struggles, triumphs, and legendary voice that shaped Hollywood and beyond.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中.溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥,覓食和躲避掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is now June, and the park is bathed in 17 hours of daylight. With the warm temperatures come rich pickings, but for the newborn the summer months are crucial as they learn to fight, find food and avoid predators.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 秋季是雄鹿爭相繁殖,魚鷹雛鳥開展3000英裡西非遷徙,三文魚返回牠們出生的河流,極北蝰產子的季節.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is when stags compete to breed, osprey chicks begin a 3000-mile migration to West Africa, salmon return to the rivers where they were born and adders give birth to live young.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天溫和潮濕,對不同動物來說,是好消息,也可以是壞消息.歐洲馬鹿被逼移到更高的地方,三文魚已經半年沒有食物,山兔變成了顯眼的白色,松鼠將自己的幼崽趕出巢穴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The winter is mild and wet, which is good news for some but bad news for others. Red deer are forced to higher ground, salmon have gone six months without food, mountain hares turn a conspicuous white, and squirrels kick their own young out of the ne

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoo’s bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, It’s a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見鞋履設計師歐瑪.貝利,他正改寫運動鞋文化.歐瑪的 FCTRY LAb 為音樂人與運動員創造創新鞋款,如今他將以 ARCH 為靈感設計全新靴子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Omar Bailey, a shoe designer revolutionizing sneaker culture. Omar’s FCTRY LAb has created innovative shoes for musicians and athletes. Now, he』ll create a boot inspired by ARCH.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德前往斯洛維尼亞,拜訪伊戈爾.阿克拉波維奇--一位為 MotoGP 傳奇車手打造排氣系統的工程師.隨著深入了解,ARCH 也將與他合作全新計畫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard travel to Slovenia to meet Igor Akrapovič. Igor’s company is an exhaust engineer known by MotoGP legends. As they learn from Igor, Arch will collaborate with him on a new project.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見享譽全球的雕塑家佩姬.布拉德利--她親手摧毀自己的藝術作品,只為創造全新的表達.透過火焰與想像,她揭示創作的真諦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Paige Bradley, a world-famous sculptor who destroyed her own art to create something new. Using fire and imagination, Paige offers insight into creativity and the artistic process.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這裡擁有地中海一些最美麗的希臘神廟,似乎漂浮在海上的城市,還有地球上其中一個威力最大的火山,義大利這地區感覺就如平行世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With some of the most beautiful Greek temples on the Mediterranean, cities that just seem to float above the sea, and one of the most powerful volcanoes on Earth, this region of Italy feels like another world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看英國蘭卡斯特轟炸機如何出廠並投入行動,對德國進行毀滅性攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the British bomber Lancaster flew out of the factory and into action, leading devastating attacks on Germany.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園.懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子.兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為力的奇觀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is spring, and migrating ospreys return to the park. Pregnant red deer come down from the mountain tops to the lowlands to calve. On a mountainside, two big cocks fight for the right to mate in a spectacle called a lek.

epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯大黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥斯大黎加 : 大自然的面紗 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯大黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在智利託雷斯德爾潘恩,雪山融水注入指狀峽灣,延伸至海洋並匯入洋流,降低海水鹽度.河口,濕地孕育眾多涉禽,而無數海灣與港口則吸引稀有的海豚與虎鯨.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Chiles Torres del Paine melt from snow-covered mountains feeds finger-like fjords as they reach out to the sea to join the current lowering its salinity. Rivers estuaries and wetlands are home to many wading birds and the countless inlets and bay

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在東京廣闊的城市版圖中探索一種飲食文化,它不僅維持了工薪族的風格,還保留了其烹飪傳統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the vast urban sprawl of Tokyo, Adam Liaw explores a food culture that not only sustains the `salaryman workers in style but retains culinary traditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明查訪了一些東京的瘋狂美食餐廳,品嚐了一些有趣的菜式,包括用雞的生殖器官製成的日式烤雞串.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw checks out the restaurants of food-crazy Tokyo and tastes some interesting dishes including Yakitori made from the reproductive organs of chickens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在蓬勃發展傳統文化的京都遇到了一位茗茶大師,一位藝伎和一位將義大利飯變成壽司的米芝蓮大廚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明探索日本充滿活力的金融中心- 大阪,發現世上最好的快餐,一位相撲力士出身的大廚,以及味道令人死而無憾的蕎麥麵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw explores Japans high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the worlds best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.

epg.programme_title_tc: 摩根費裡曼:不可思議的生涯

epg.programme_title_en: Celine Dion: The Heart Goes On
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席琳.狄翁是家喻戶曉的名字,象徵著無與倫比的音樂才華.然而,她的人生並非一帆風順.跟隨我們一同揭開傳奇背後的故事--從聲名鵲起的爆紅之路,到塑造她非凡事業的個人考驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celine Dion is a household name, synonymous with musical brilliance. Yet, her life has not been untouched by hardship. Join us as we uncover the story behind the legend, her meteoric rise to fame, and the personal trials that shaped her remarkable ca

epg.programme_title_tc: 丹佐華盛頓:美國代表人物
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部深度紀錄片探討丹佐・華盛頓的非凡歷程,這位影壇巨星重新定義了好萊塢領銜男演員的形象與影響力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This in-depth documentary explores the remarkable journey of Denzel Washington, a powerhouse actor who has redefined what it means to be a leading man in Hollywood.

epg.programme_title_tc: 揭秘芭比:分裂的夢幻屋
epg.programme_title_en: Barbie Uncovered: A Dream House Divided
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《揭秘芭比:分裂的夢幻屋》揭示創作芭比娃娃背後的戲劇性真實故事,重點講述聯合創作者羅絲韓德勒和傑克瑞恩的高山與低谷,以及他們標誌性又備受爭議發明的持久影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Barbie Uncovered reveals the dramatic true story behind Barbie’s creation, spotlighting the rise and fallout of co-creators Ruth Handler and Jack Ryan, and the lasting impact of their iconic, controversial invention.

epg.programme_title_tc: 惠妮休斯頓: 天籟背後
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一段震撼人心的旅程,深入描繪惠妮.休斯頓如流星般崛起的人生--從福音音樂的根源到全球巨星的巔峰,揭開錯綜複雜的情感關係,與成癮搏鬥的陰影,以及那把曾無可動搖,最終令人心碎的嗓音,在她英年早逝前的起落沉浮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A powerful journey into the meteoric rise of Whitney Houston - from her gospel roots to global superstardom - unraveling the tangled relationships, haunting battles with addiction, and the heartbreaking fall of a once-unshakable voice, before her unt

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖拜登於2021年1月20日就任美國第46任總統,承諾在分裂的時代後團結和鎮靜,目標是恢復美國魂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joe Biden became the 46th US President on Jan 20, 2021, promising unity and calm after a divided era, aiming to restore the soul of America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當川普的總統任期(2017-2021)在一片爭議和社會變革中過渡,對國家和世界產生了良久影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Donald Trumps presidency (2017-2021) was marked by controversy and societal shifts, leaving a lasting impact on the nation and world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 巴拉克歐巴馬是首位非裔美國總統,體現了希望,正義,寬容和平等,以他的信息和傳承啟發數百萬人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Barack Obama, the 1st African-American US President, embodied hope, justice, tolerance, and equality, inspiring millions with his message and legacy.

epg.programme_title_tc: 丹佐華盛頓:美國代表人物
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部深度紀錄片探討丹佐・華盛頓的非凡歷程,這位影壇巨星重新定義了好萊塢領銜男演員的形象與影響力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This in-depth documentary explores the remarkable journey of Denzel Washington, a powerhouse actor who has redefined what it means to be a leading man in Hollywood.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片探討賀錦麗從早年加州的生活到成為首位美國女性副總統的崛起經過,她對美國政壇的影響以及她有望成為首位女總統的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary explores Kamala Harriss rise from her early life in California to becoming the first female Vice President of the United States, her impact on American politics, and her potential path to becoming the first female President.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沒有多少電影製作人能像史蒂芬史匹柏一樣在業內50多年間如此生生不息和擁有影響力,他從亞利桑那州郊區到好萊塢聚光燈下的旅程是有史以來最偉大的故事之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With over 50 years in the industry, not many filmmakers can boast the longevity and influence of Steven Spielberg, whose journey from the suburbs of Arizona to the spotlight of Hollywood is one of the greatest stories ever told.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看英國蘭卡斯特轟炸機如何出廠並投入行動,對德國進行毀滅性攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the British bomber Lancaster flew out of the factory and into action, leading devastating attacks on Germany.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解龍捲風戰鬥轟炸機如何及為何在多年來不同場合都大派用場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how and why the fighter-bomber Panavia Tornado has been so useful in so many roles for so many years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮如何展現她成熟的演員天賦,還有紅顏薄命的她剛戰勝二十世紀霍士就香消玉殞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores how Marilyn shows her mature talent as an actress and wins a triumphant victory over Twentieth Century Fox shortly before her untimely death.

epg.programme_title_tc: 揭秘芭比:分裂的夢幻屋
epg.programme_title_en: Barbie Uncovered: A Dream House Divided
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《揭秘芭比:分裂的夢幻屋》揭示創作芭比娃娃背後的戲劇性真實故事,重點講述聯合創作者羅絲韓德勒和傑克瑞恩的高山與低谷,以及他們標誌性又備受爭議發明的持久影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Barbie Uncovered reveals the dramatic true story behind Barbie’s creation, spotlighting the rise and fallout of co-creators Ruth Handler and Jack Ryan, and the lasting impact of their iconic, controversial invention.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖拜登於2021年1月20日就任美國第46任總統,承諾在分裂的時代後團結和鎮靜,目標是恢復美國魂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joe Biden became the 46th US President on Jan 20, 2021, promising unity and calm after a divided era, aiming to restore the soul of America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當川普的總統任期(2017-2021)在一片爭議和社會變革中過渡,對國家和世界產生了良久影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Donald Trumps presidency (2017-2021) was marked by controversy and societal shifts, leaving a lasting impact on the nation and world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 巴拉克歐巴馬是首位非裔美國總統,體現了希望,正義,寬容和平等,以他的信息和傳承啟發數百萬人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Barack Obama, the 1st African-American US President, embodied hope, justice, tolerance, and equality, inspiring millions with his message and legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. It’s time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. It’s time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在蓬勃發展傳統文化的京都遇到了一位茗茶大師,一位藝伎和一位將義大利飯變成壽司的米芝蓮大廚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明探索日本充滿活力的金融中心- 大阪,發現世上最好的快餐,一位相撲力士出身的大廚,以及味道令人死而無憾的蕎麥麵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw explores Japans high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the worlds best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在日本南部的九州和四國,廖崇明發現了一個充滿活力,溫馨的文化,該地的美食跟人民一樣迷人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Japans southern islands of Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往沖繩結束他的日本美食之旅,他在當地發現一道集大成的美食,並瞭解了長壽的秘訣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam ends his taste tour through Japan with a trip to the island of Okinawa, where he discovers an eclectic cuisine and learns the secret to long life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在日本發現了一連串樂趣.在寒冷的北海道北島上,他品嚐了海膽,池沼公魚和精緻的芝士蛋糕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw discovers a host of delights in Japan. On the wintry northern island of Hokkaido, he samples sea urchin, pond smelt and boutique cheesecake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明與漁民們一起出海,抓捕到所謂的百萬金槍.他還遇到一位在2011年海嘯中救了他員工的豉油製造商.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes to sea with the fishermen who caught the so-called `million-dollar tuna. He also meets a soy sauce maker who saved his staff from the 2011 tsunami.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德拜訪提姆.艾利斯--這位年輕執行長是相對論太空公司的創辦人,該公司打造並發射了全球第一枚3D列印火箭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Tim Ellis. A young CEO, Tim is the founder of Relativity Space, the company that built and launched the world’s first 3D printed rocket.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德獲得前所未有的機會,進入全球最神秘的藝術作品之一--詹姆斯.特瑞爾的〈羅登火山口〉.在這座火山口中,藝術以光與宇宙為題展開探索.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard are given unprecedented access to one of the world’s most guarded artworks: James Turrell’s Roden Crater. Inside the volcanic crater, the art explores the use of light and the cosmos.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見鞋履設計師歐瑪.貝利,他正改寫運動鞋文化.歐瑪的 FCTRY LAb 為音樂人與運動員創造創新鞋款,如今他將以 ARCH 為靈感設計全新靴子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Omar Bailey, a shoe designer revolutionizing sneaker culture. Omar’s FCTRY LAb has created innovative shoes for musicians and athletes. Now, he』ll create a boot inspired by ARCH.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在日本的中心狼吞虎嚥著素壽司和拉麵.他從新學習煮蕎麥麵,自製麻糬,並參加傳統茶道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of Japan, Mena devours plant-based sushi and ramen. He learns to cook soba noodles from scratch, home-made mochi, and takes part in a traditional tea ceremony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在世界著名的克魯格國家公園及附近開展第二趟南非美食之行.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren commences his second Food Trail of South Africa in the world famous Kruger National Park and surrounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 約翰尼斯堡是探索南非的門戶城市!華倫在本集沉迷於深受當地人和遊客喜愛的桑頓區及周邊和精彩的國際口味.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johannesburg - the gateway city to exploring South Africa! In this episode Warren indulges in the vibrant international flavours and surrounds of the Sandton neighbourhood, loved by locals and visitors alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在你從未見過的南非狂野東北海岸,華倫會發現自己愛上那空蕩蕩的海灘,粗獷的開放汪洋和充滿野生河馬的水道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wild northeast coast of South Africa is like nothing you』ve seen. And it’s here Warren will find himself romanced by empty beaches, rugged open oceans, and waterways filled with wild hippopotamus.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在本集體驗當地豐富的野生物種,他主要在追蹤和尋找難以捉摸並瀕臨絕種的非洲野狗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, Warren experiences the abundance of wildlife here, centering his experience around tracking and finding the elusive and endangered African Wild Dog.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花園大道果真是南非的滄海遺珠,它是一條延伸200公裡的沿海公路,以其迷人的多樣性和無出其右的荒野而聞名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A true hidden gem of South Africa, the Garden Route is a 200km stretch of coastal highway known for its beguiling diversity and unparalleled spirit of wilderness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫抵達開普敦,這不會是這座城市的平凡美食探索之旅;華倫在整集節目中致力深入研究南非一種特殊的烹飪風格- 開普馬來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren has arrived into Cape Town. This won’t be your average culinary exploration of a city; Warren has dedicated the entire episode to diving into a specific style of South African cooking known as 『Cape Malay』.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在法蘭史霍克山谷探索博殊真度紅酒莊的無盡產物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is in the Franschhoek Valley, exploring the endless bounty of Boschendal Wine Estate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫繼續從心出發,前往更鮮為人知的赫爾馬努斯小鎮,在當地參觀紐頓莊臣-風景優美的紅酒農場,從而加深對紅酒的熱愛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Continuing to listen to his heart, Warren deepens his love of wine by venturing to the lesser known town of Hermanus, where he』ll visit Newton Johnson, the 『wine farm with a view』.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫正離開開普敦前往西開普省更寧靜的沿海地區和風景如畫的帕特諾斯特小鎮.他在當地會驚嘆海邊村莊的氛圍,並沿著海灘騎電動單車.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is heading out of Cape Town into the more quiet coastal area of the Western Cape, and the picturesque town of Paternoster. It’s here he』ll marvel at the seaside village feel and take an e-bike ride along the beach.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 作為華倫南非美食之旅的最後一章,他回歸叢林,這是所有前往彩虹國度旅行的精髓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the final stanza in Warren’s Food Trail of South Africa, he’s back in the bush, a quintessential part of all travel to the rainbow nation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沒有多少電影製作人能像史蒂芬史匹柏一樣在業內50多年間如此生生不息和擁有影響力,他從亞利桑那州郊區到好萊塢聚光燈下的旅程是有史以來最偉大的故事之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With over 50 years in the industry, not many filmmakers can boast the longevity and influence of Steven Spielberg, whose journey from the suburbs of Arizona to the spotlight of Hollywood is one of the greatest stories ever told.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自60年前導演的處女作面世,馬丁史柯西斯一生一直致力為電影的過去,現在和未來打拼.他被稱為電影保母,他不斷突破電影製作的極限.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 60 years since his directorial debut, Martin Scorseses life has been dedicated to the past, present and future of cinema. Named Caretaker of Cinema, Martin Scorsese continues to push the boundaries of moviemaking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自90年代初,昆汀塔倫提諾一直乘坐從不減速的電影過山車,這也鞏固了他那世上最具影響力的電影製作人之一的地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Since the early 1990s, Quentin Tarantino has been on a cinematic rollercoaster ride, that’s never looked like slowing down, that has cemented himself as one of the worlds most influential filmmakers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解龍捲風戰鬥轟炸機如何及為何在多年來不同場合都大派用場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how and why the fighter-bomber Panavia Tornado has been so useful in so many roles for so many years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從越戰的叢林到中東的沙漠戰爭,見證 F-111戰鬥轟炸機的行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the fighter-bomber F-111 in action, from the jungle battles of Vietnam to the desert wars of the Middle East.
